title: Tele Sales Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities We are hiring a Telesales / Inside Sales Executive to convert prospective customers into paying clients through phone calls and WhatsApp. This is a full-time, office-based role focused on new customer sales, with no team management responsibilities. Lead handling and consultation: Contact assigned leads, understand customer needs and explain the companys services clearly. Communicate the service scope, duration, pricing, first payment and subsequent payment schedule. Maintain consistent follow-ups and record the outcome and next action for each lead. Commercial proposals: Prepare and send commercial proposals using approved company templates. Confirm that the customer has received the proposal, answer questions, handle objections and follow up to move the opportunity towards a decision. Closing sales and collecting the first payment: Secure the customers agreement to the approved service terms, share company payment details or payment links and follow through until the first payment is received. Verify payment through approved systems or the Finance team and record the transaction in the CRM. Service agreement: Prepare the service agreement using the approved template, check customer details and arrange signing by the customer and an authorised company representative. Share the signed agreement with the customer and save it in the companys system. Handover to Customer Success: After the first payment is confirmed and the agreement is signed, transfer the customer to the Customer Success team. Provide the signed agreement, payment confirmation, agreed service terms, payment schedule and any outstanding questions. Confirm that the assigned Customer Success specialist has accepted the handover. CRM and reporting: Keep accurate records of calls, WhatsApp conversations, proposals, follow-ups, payments, agreements and handovers. Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline and report progress to the sales supervisor. Probation and sales targets: The probation period is three months. Monthly targets for confirmed first payments from new customers are 50,000 in Month 1, 80,000 in Month 2 and at least 100,000 in Month 3. After probation, the monthly target is at least 100,000. These are separate monthly targets, not cumulative totals. Ongoing customer support, repeat-payment follow-ups, debt recovery and handling calls from collection agents are not part of this role. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 1–3 years of experience in telesales, inside sales, B2C sales or selling services over the phone. Experience converting enquiries into confirmed customer payments is preferred. Strong spoken Hindi and English , with clear and professional written communication on WhatsApp. Confident in conducting customer consultations, presenting proposals, handling objections and closing sales. Able to explain service terms accurately without making misleading claims or unauthorised promises. Organised and consistent with follow-ups, comfortable managing multiple leads and working towards monthly sales targets. Basic CRM, spreadsheet and computer skills are required. Education: Any Graduate. Must be available for full-time work from the office . This is an individual contributor position, not a team leader or sales management role. 


 Perks and benefits 
 Fixed monthly salary of 30,000 , equivalent to 3,60,000 per year, excluding sales commission. 30% sales commission on confirmed first payments from new customers whose sales are credited to the employee. Commission applies only to the initial payment, not to subsequent monthly payments. Transparent earning structure: For example, 100,000 in eligible first customer payments generates 30,000 in commission. Combined with the 30,000 fixed salary, this results in 60,000 total monthly earnings before applicable deductions. This is an illustration, not guaranteed total earnings; actual commission depends on eligible sales and the agreed commission policy. Focused sales responsibilities: Once payment, agreement signing and handover are complete, a dedicated Customer Success team manages ongoing customer support and repeat-payment follow-ups, allowing you to focus on new sales.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Job Summary 
 You will be the first point of contact for prospective customers. You own incoming leads from the moment they enter the pipeline - contacting prospects quickly, understanding their needs, qualifying the opportunity, scheduling demos and following up until they move forward. Your work makes sure genuine opportunities are never lost to a slow reply or a missed follow-up. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Incoming leads (primary)

Follow up persistently across calls, WhatsApp, email and other channels, and re-engage leads that have gone cold. Following up until prospects are qualified, disqualified or moved into a nurture pipeline. 
 
 What we are looking for 
 1-3 years in B2B sales, inside sales, business development, telesales or SaaS sales. Strong verbal and written communication; comfortable speaking with business owners, operations and HR teams, and senior decision-makers. Excellent follow-up discipline across many channels, and the judgement to tell genuine opportunities from low-intent enquiries. Organised enough to manage a large number of leads at once without losing track. Comfortable with defined targets and conversion metrics. Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools is a plus. description:
Job Description in brief: The role is responsible for driving corporate and enterprise sales for employee transport services by acquiring new clients and managing the complete sales lifecycle. The position focuses on understanding client transportation needs, designing customized solutions, negotiating contracts, and closing deals while ensuring revenue growth and target achievement. The role also involves building long-term relationships with key stakeholders, maintaining a strong sales pipeline, collaborating with operations for effective service delivery, and expanding existing accounts through retention, upselling, and cross-selling. A strong result-oriented mindset, independent account management, and on-ground B2B sales experience in employee transport are essential.

Own the complete sales lifecycle: prospecting, client meetings, proposal development, negotiations, deal closure, and payment follow-ups. Understand client travel requirements, corporate travel, employee transport, and design customized commercial proposals. Build and sustain long-term strategic relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders. Lead pricing and contract negotiations in alignment with company margins and approval frameworks. Analyze account performance to improve retention and expand revenue through upselling and cross-selling. Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and report revenue forecasts, closures, and target achievement. Collaborate with operations teams to improve service delivery, client satisfaction, and market penetration. Represent the company professionally in client meetings, industry events, and corporate transport-related business discussions. Job specifications: (To publish in the advertisement and for screening purpose) Graduate in any discipline; post-graduate qualification preferred. 2 to 3 years of experience in business development or corporate sales,preferably in the Service Industry. Strong negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with proven on-ground B2B sales experience in employee transport. Ability to independently manage regional targets and key accounts. Willingness to travel extensively as per business requirements. Result-driven mindset with strong ownership of revenue, accounts, and closures. Proficiency in English and Tamil (spoken and written). Should have the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines and should be able to exercise professional Judgement. title: Sales Development Representative - RCM Services
description:
Lets be real RCM is crowded. Everyone claims to do billing, coding, AR follow-up, and denial management like its revolutionary. We don t need someone to parrot the pitch. We need someone who can open doors in closed markets, make providers stop and listen, and drive the first wedge in crowded conversations. At blueBriX, we deliver end-to-end RCM services for U.S.-based healthcare providers who are done losing revenue to broken systems, slow follow-up, and outsourced chaos. Your mission Create awareness. Build demand. Start the conversation. This role is not for: People who love templates and mass emails Folks who panic at cold anything Anyone who needs a lead handed to them with a bow on it This role is for: Strategic prospectors who understand healthcare lingo and provider pain points People who can speak to billing managers, practice owners, and CFOs without blinking Professionals who know how to turn curiosity into a calendar booking The first line of offense in the sales engine What you ll do: Identify and qualify new prospects through research, outreach, and hustle Send personalized, high-converting emails and messages that don t end up in Trash Make cold calls that actually land Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to refine targeting and messaging Educate prospects on how blueBriX RCM can stop revenue leaks and speed up cashflow Track every interaction like a hawk-because data builds momentum You ll thrive here if: You have 1-3 years of experience in sales or business development-preferably in RCM, healthcare BPO, or B2B services You re a research ninja, a strong communicator, and an even better listener You can turn just exploring into let s schedule a demo You don t need handholding, but know how to loop in the team when the moment s right You bring hunger, humility, and relentless follow-up Bonus if: You ve prospected into U.S. physician practices, medical groups, or ambulatory care centers You understand RCM basics-denials, aging AR, clean claims, clearinghouses, and the real revenue killers You ve worked with CRM tools (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce-we don t care, as long as you use it well) Location: Kochi, India (in-office)Reports To: RCM Sales Lead Vertical: U.S. Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management You re not just warming up leads. You re lighting the fuse. EH If you love the chase, know how to get attention in a crowded inbox, and want to be the reason a deal starts-this is your shot. Let s open the market-one conversation at a time.

title: Sr. Executive - Sales (Chemicals / Specialty Chemical / Lab Chemicals)
description:
INTRODUCTION K. Patel Group is a diversified, multi-location manufacturing group with a strong presence across Dyes, Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals, Herbal Extracts, Metal, and Realty. The Group is on a strong growth trajectory through new projects and modernization of existing facilities. 
 The Executive / Sr. Executive BD at K. Patel International will be responsible for driving business growth in Specialty Chemicals, Lab Chemicals, and Dyes through strategic market development, customer acquisition, sales execution, sourcing, export commercial costing, and long-term relationship management in line with regulatory and industry requirements. 
 MARKETING & BUSINESS STRATEGY Identify and develop new product segments, markets, applications, and business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers. Understand customer requirements and provide technical-commercial solutions. Respond to customer enquiries, proposals, and RFPs in coordination with internal teams. Prepare product concepts, segment-wise presentations, and marketing material for customers, exhibitions, trade shows, and conferences. Source and manage lab chemicals, specialty chemicals, and dyes product requirements. 
 SALES & BUSINESS OPERATIONS Generate and qualify business leads and convert enquiries into sustainable business opportunities. Conduct cold calling, outbound sales activities, client meetings, negotiations, and deal closures. Develop, retain, and grow customer accounts through consistent follow-ups and relationship management. Maintain and update prospect and customer databases using CRM, Excel, Salesforce, or other approved systems. Obtain quotations from suppliers for product requirements, negotiate prices and commercial terms, and follow up with suppliers for timely quotations, order processing, and delivery. Track quotations, active and inactive leads, appointments, customer interactions, and conversions. Achieve or exceed assigned annual sales, revenue, and business development targets. 
 EXPORT COSTING, FREIGHT & INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS Coordinate with CHAs, freight forwarders, shipping agents, and logistics partners to obtain competitive freight rates, customs clearance charges, port charges, documentation charges, and other export-related costs. Obtain, compare, and negotiate freight quotations for different destinations, shipment sizes, and modes of transport. Calculate export selling prices in USD and other applicable currencies by incorporating product cost, packing, inland transportation, CHA/port charges, freight, insurance, applicable margins, and other associated costs. Prepare customer-specific international quotations based on applicable Incoterms, including EXW, FCA, FOB, CFR/CNF, CIF, DAP, and DDP, as required. Ensure accurate INR-to-USD and foreign-currency conversions using approved exchange-rate assumptions. Prepare and evaluate end-to-end export costing and ensure that quotations reflect correct freight, Incoterms, payment terms, validity, delivery terms, and margins. Maintain an updated database of freight rates, CHA charges, shipping costs, port charges, and other export-related expenses. Coordinate with internal teams, CHAs, and freight forwarders for shipment planning, export documentation, dispatch schedules, and timely delivery. 
 REVENUE MANAGEMENT & PLANNING Collaborate with management on sales planning, forecasting, and target setting. Prepare sales budgets, customer-wise and segment-wise revenue targets. Maintain an updated sales pipeline and ensure accurate reporting through CRM systems. Support short-term and long-term business development planning initiatives. Monitor customer profitability and commercial viability of opportunities in coordination with management. 
 KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong knowledge of chemical / pharmaceutical industry regulations and compliance. Understanding of drug laws, patents, trademarks, manufacturing processes, and relevant commercial considerations. Awareness of government policies related to drugs, chemicals, and healthcare programs. Sound understanding of drug development phases, generic development, and regulatory processes. Strong marketing strategy, negotiation, customer engagement, and business development skills. Excellent networking, communication, presentation, and relationship-building capabilities. Strong understanding of export costing, international freight, CHA/customs processes, shipping documentation, and Incoterms 2020. Ability to independently calculate EXW, FOB, CFR/CNF, CIF, DAP, and DDP pricing and convert domestic costing into competitive international selling prices. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate product cost, supplier quotations, freight, logistics costs, margins, and international selling prices. Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel/CRM tools for costing, reporting, pipeline management, and sales analysis. 
 QUALIFICATION Bachelors Degree / M.Sc. / MBA; Science / Chemistry preferred. 
 EXPERIENCE Minimum 7+ years of experience in Business Development / Sales. Experience in Specialty Chemicals, Dyes, Lab Chemicals, export sales, or international business is preferred. 
 INDUSTRY TYPE Chemicals & Dyes

title: Assistant Sales Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 SALES MANAGER FIVE-STAR HOTEL 
 1. Position Details 
 ParticularDetailsJob Title Sales Manager Department Sales & Marketing Reports To Director of Sales / Director of Sales & Marketing / General Manager Location Hotel Property Department Head Director of Sales & Marketing Job Level Middle Management 2. Job Purpose 
The Sales Manager is responsible for generating and maximizing hotel revenue by developing new business, maintaining existing accounts, building strong corporate and agency relationships, increasing room and banquet sales, and achieving the hotel's sales targets.
The position will actively promote the hotel's accommodation, restaurants, banquets, meetings, conferences, weddings, events and other revenue-generating facilities.

 3. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Sales & Revenue Generation 
 Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets assigned by management. Generate room, banquet, F&B, conference, wedding and event business. Identify new business opportunities and develop new accounts. Increase the hotel's market share through effective sales strategies. Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and continuously follow up on potential business. Develop business from corporate, government, travel trade, MICE, wedding, social and other market segments. Monitor competitor activities, rates, packages and promotional activities. Implement sales strategies in line with the hotel's business plan. B. Corporate Sales 
 Identify and approach potential corporate clients. Conduct regular sales calls and client visits. Develop long-term relationships with corporate accounts. Negotiate corporate rates within approved guidelines. Generate room nights, meetings, conferences and F&B business from corporate accounts. Conduct periodic account reviews and identify opportunities for additional business. Maintain an updated corporate account database. C. Travel Trade & Agency Business 
 Develop relationships with travel agents, tour operators, DMCs and online travel partners. Promote hotel packages and special offers to travel trade partners. Negotiate contracts and rates as per management approval. Monitor production from contracted agencies. Conduct regular sales calls and presentations to key travel partners. D. MICE, Banquet & Events 
 Generate leads for meetings, conferences, exhibitions, weddings and social events. Conduct site inspections for prospective clients. Prepare proposals and quotations in coordination with the relevant departments. Follow up on event enquiries and convert leads into confirmed business. Coordinate with Banquets, F&B, Front Office and other departments to ensure smooth execution. Maintain proper records of tentative and confirmed events. E. Client Relationship Management 
 Maintain excellent relationships with existing and prospective clients. Conduct regular client meetings and courtesy calls. Understand client requirements and provide suitable hotel solutions. Handle client complaints and coordinate with concerned departments for resolution. Obtain client feedback after events and stays. Encourage repeat business and referrals. Maintain a professional network within the local business community. F. Sales Calls & Business Development 
 Prepare and execute daily and weekly sales-call plans. Conduct face-to-face meetings, telephone calls and online meetings with clients. Visit corporate offices, travel agencies, event companies and other potential accounts. Participate in trade shows, exhibitions, networking events and promotional activities. Conduct hotel presentations and sales blitzes. Generate and qualify new leads regularly. G. Sales Administration & Reporting 
 Maintain accurate records of all sales activities. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales reports. Maintain sales call reports and client visit reports. Update the sales pipeline and business forecast. Maintain records of enquiries, proposals and conversions. Monitor account production against contracted targets. Submit competitor and market intelligence reports. Ensure all sales documentation is properly maintained. H. Revenue & Pricing Coordination 
 Work closely with Revenue Management and Reservations to maximize room revenue. Understand occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and room availability. Ensure negotiated rates are within approved pricing guidelines. Monitor rate competitiveness in the market. Communicate market trends and business opportunities to the Director of Sales. Support strategies for increasing occupancy during need periods. I. Internal Coordination 
 Coordinate closely with Front Office, Reservations, Housekeeping, F&B, Banquets, Finance and Operations. Communicate confirmed business requirements accurately to operating departments. Attend sales and operations meetings. Ensure special client requirements are communicated and followed up. Assist operational departments in maintaining strong client relationships. J. Guest & Client Experience 
 Ensure VIP and important corporate clients receive appropriate attention. Personally follow up with key clients during their stay or event whenever required. Ensure client expectations are clearly communicated to the hotel team. Follow up after departure/event completion to obtain feedback. Support the hotel in maintaining high guest satisfaction and reputation. 
 4. Key Performance Areas (KPIs) 
The Sales Manager may be evaluated on:
 Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets. Room-night production. Revenue generated from assigned accounts. New corporate account acquisition. Banquet and event revenue. MICE business generation. Client retention and repeat business. Conversion ratio of sales enquiries. Number and quality of sales calls. Sales pipeline value. Average Daily Rate (ADR) contribution. Market segment performance. Collection/payment follow-up in coordination with Finance. Customer satisfaction and client feedback. Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports. 
 5. Authority & Decision-Making 
 Negotiate business within approved hotel rate and discount guidelines. Recommend special rates and packages for management approval. Recommend new corporate accounts and business opportunities. Recommend credit facilities subject to hotel policy and approval. Prioritize sales activities based on revenue potential. Escalate pricing, contractual or commercial issues beyond delegated authority. 
 6. Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Business Management, Sales & Marketing or a related field. Relevant certification in Sales/Marketing is an advantage. Good knowledge of hotel sales practices and the local market. Experience 
 Preferably 47 years of experience in hotel sales, with relevant experience in a 4/5-star hotel environment. Experience in corporate sales, MICE, banquets, weddings and travel trade is desirable. Strong knowledge of the local corporate and business market is preferred. 
 7. Required Skills & Competencies 
 Sales Skills 
 Business development Negotiation skills Lead generation Account management Presentation skills Closing techniques Networking Hotel Knowledge 
 Room inventory and room categories Hotel packages and promotions Banquet and event operations F&B products and services Revenue management fundamentals Market segmentation Personal Competencies 
 Excellent communication skills Customer-focused approach Strong interpersonal skills Professional grooming and presentation Target-oriented approach Time management Problem-solving ability Teamwork Positive attitude Ability to work under pressure Technology Skills 
 MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint Hotel Property Management System (PMS) Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems Sales & Catering system, where applicable Email and digital communication platforms 
 8. Key Interfaces 
The Sales Manager regularly coordinates with:
 General Manager Director of Sales & Marketing Revenue Manager Front Office Reservations Food & Beverage Banquets Housekeeping Finance & Accounts Human Resources Engineering Security 
 9. General Responsibilities 
 Follow all hotel policies, SOPs and standards. Maintain confidentiality of guest and company information. Maintain professional grooming and appearance. Follow all safety, security and statutory requirements. Protect hotel assets and commercial interests. Maintain professional conduct with clients and colleagues. Participate in hotel training and development programmes. Perform any additional responsibilities assigned by the General Manager or Director of Sales & Marketing. Job Objective 
 To maximize hotel revenue, expand the customer base, retain key accounts and build long-term business relationships while consistently achieving the hotel's sales and profitability objectives.

description:
Powering the agentic revolution in travel. Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide. We are seeking a Sales Support Manager to join our global Airline Solutions Operations team. This team plays a critical role in improving commercial operations, managing airline technology change requests and ensuring accurate customer billing across our airline solutions portfolio. 
 In this role, you will work closely with senior commercial, product, technology and finance leaders to improve operational efficiency, strengthen contract compliance and protect revenue. You will have significant exposure across Sabres global organization and the opportunity to shape processes that support our airline customers. 
 As Sales Support Manager, you will take ownership of complex operational initiatives across three key areas: Change Request (CR) management, customer billing compliance and airline messaging services. You will serve as a key link between commercial teams, technology partners and internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution and resolution of issues. 
 This role requires someone with sharp commercial acumen, operational rigor and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a global matrix environment. 
 What youll do Coordinate the end-to-end Change Request (CR) estimation process, track deliverables and timelines, resolve bottlenecks and escalate delays to ensure timely execution. Work with technology partners, and internal Product and Technology teams to monitor service commitments, resolve issues and improve operational performance. Review airline customer agreements and billing records to identify discrepancies, validate charges and resolve issues with Sales, Finance and Billing teams. Review contractual billing arrangements for web services, APIs, EDIFACT and other airline messaging transactions to identify inaccuracies and prevent potential revenue leakage. Establish clear operational workflows, tracking mechanisms and performance indicators, while supporting process automation and system improvements to increase efficiency and transparency. Collaborate with senior stakeholders across global teams to drive timely decisions, resolve operational challenges and present performance updates and recommendations to leadership and steering committees. 
 
 What youll bring 
 Required qualifications Minimum 10 years of professional experience in airline technology, enterprise IT services or technology consulting, including substantial experience in commercial operations, account management or technology delivery. Solid knowledge of commercial agreements, customer billing processes and revenue-related workflows, with the ability to interpret contractual terms and identify billing discrepancies. Working knowledge of technology concepts such as APIs, web services, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Proven ability to coordinate complex, cross-functional activities, manage competing priorities and influence senior stakeholders without direct reporting authority. Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills, with proficiency in Excel and experience managing operational tracking and reporting. High level of initiative, self-motivation and accountability. 
 Preferred qualifications Strong understanding of airline business operations and technology solutions, including EDIFACT, NDC and how airline systems and services interact. Experience coordinating third-party technology vendors, managing commercial change requests or ensuring customer billing compliance. Experience with workflow management systems, process automation and operational improvement initiatives. . . #LI-Hybrid#LI-MF1

JOB DESCRIPTION Sales Manager Individual Contributor (IC) 1. Position Details Company: Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd.
 Position: Sales Manager – Individual Contributor (IC)
 Department: Sales & Business Development
 Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Work Model: On-Site
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Minimum Qualification: Graduate in any discipline
 Experience: Minimum 3 years in sales / business development preferred
 Compensation: Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives
 Reporting To: Director – Sales & Marketing / Senior Management 
 2. About Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd. Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd. is a business consulting, management advisory and exhibition organisation company specialising in the Gems & Jewellery industry. The company creates business opportunities through B2B exhibitions, trade shows, networking platforms, memberships, branding, marketing and sales consultancy for jewellery manufacturers and retailers across India and international markets. 3. Job Purpose The Sales Manager – Individual Contributor (IC) will independently drive sales, generate new business, acquire clients and achieve assigned revenue targets. This is a hands-on sales role focused on individual performance, client acquisition, negotiations and deal closures rather than managing a team. The candidate will be responsible for building a strong sales pipeline, developing relationships with jewellery manufacturers and business owners, and generating measurable revenue for Jewel Trendz. 4. Key Responsibilities A. Individual Sales & Revenue Generation Independently achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets. Generate revenue through exhibitions, trade shows, sponsorships, memberships and other assigned business verticals. Identify potential clients, conduct sales calls, present proposals, negotiate and close deals. Maintain a consistent sales pipeline and convert qualified prospects into paying customers. Drive repeat business, upselling and cross-selling opportunities. B. Business Development & Client Acquisition Identify and approach jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, brands and corporate clients. Generate leads through outbound calls, WhatsApp, email, referrals, networking and industry databases. Build relationships with business owners, directors and key decision-makers. Identify new customer segments and develop opportunities within the Gems & Jewellery industry. Maintain consistent follow-ups until opportunities are converted or appropriately qualified. C. Exhibition & Event Sales Sell participation packages and exhibition stalls for Jewel Trendz Gems & Jewellery Shows, Corporate Diamond Shows, Silver Shows, Lab-Grown Diamond Jewellery Shows and other assigned events. Promote sponsorships, memberships and related commercial offerings. Communicate exhibition benefits, buyer access, networking opportunities and business potential. Drive new exhibitor acquisition and repeat participation. Coordinate with event operations and client services teams for client onboarding and participation confirmation. D. Key Account & Relationship Management Build and maintain relationships with manufacturers, retailers, exhibitors and sponsors. Understand client requirements and recommend suitable participation packages and services. Develop existing accounts and identify additional revenue opportunities. Maintain professional communication and ensure a high standard of customer service. Encourage repeat bookings, referrals and long-term business relationships. E. Sales Pipeline & Reporting Maintain accurate customer databases, lead records and sales pipeline information. Update the designated CRM or sales tracking system regularly. Submit daily activity reports and periodic sales performance updates. Track calls, meetings, proposals, conversions, bookings and pending follow-ups. Coordinate with finance regarding invoices and payment follow-ups for assigned accounts. Provide realistic sales forecasts and communicate business opportunities to management. F. Commercial Discipline & Accountability Follow approved pricing, discount structures and commercial terms. Ensure accurate communication of company services and customer commitments. Protect confidential customer information and company data. Participate in sales reviews and performance discussions. Take complete ownership of individual targets, sales closures and assigned responsibilities. 5. Qualifications & Experience Minimum graduate in any discipline. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, B2B sales or client acquisition preferred. Proven track record of independently achieving sales targets and closing business. Experience in exhibitions, events, corporate sales, memberships or the Gems & Jewellery industry will be an advantage. Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and closing skills. Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, email, WhatsApp Business and CRM systems. Strong networking, follow-up and relationship-management abilities. 6. Required Skills & Competencies Strong individual sales performance and revenue ownership. Confident prospecting, negotiation and deal-closing capabilities. Excellent communication and client-handling skills. Self-motivation and the ability to work independently. Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving abilities. Disciplined pipeline management and accurate reporting. Professional conduct, integrity and accountability. Ability to perform effectively in a target-driven environment. 7. Compensation Structure Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives Fixed monthly salary based on experience and suitability. Additional incentives linked to eligible sales, revenue generation and target achievement. Incentive calculation, eligibility and payout terms will be governed by company policy. Opportunity to increase earnings through individual sales performance. 8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated on: Achievement of individual monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Number of qualified leads generated. Lead-to-customer conversion rate. Revenue from exhibition stalls, sponsorships, memberships and assigned services. Number of new clients acquired. Repeat business, customer retention and referrals. Sales pipeline accuracy and follow-up discipline. Timely submission of reports and sales forecasts. Compliance with approved commercial terms. Contribution to payment follow-ups and collection coordination. 9. Why Join Jewel Trendz? Work directly with leading jewellery manufacturers, retailers and industry professionals. Develop a strong professional network in the Gems & Jewellery industry. Take ownership of individual business targets and revenue generation. Earn performance-based incentives in addition to a fixed salary. Build long-term career growth through measurable performance and commercial contribution. We are looking for a confident, commercially driven sales professional who can independently generate business, close deals and deliver measurable results without relying on a team of sales executives. title: Manager, Merchant Cloud Commercialization Support
description:
Manager, Merchant Cloud Commercialization Support About Mastercard 
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries all around the world. Our people, technology, data, and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities. 
 
 Overview 
 The Global Acceptance and Merchant Solutions team is on a mission to make Mastercard the best way to pay everywhere. With our powerful suite of acceptance products, including Merchant Cloud, we are helping shape the payment experiences of the future. 
 
 The Manager, Product Commercialization Support, Go-to-Market Enablement and Revenue Tracking will play a critical role in supporting the commercialization and go-to-market strategy for Merchant Cloud. 
 
 Role 
 
 This support role focused on market readiness, commercialization support, pipeline visibility, performance tracking, market penetration analysis, and go-to-market enablement under the directions of regional stakeholders. The role is not a direct sales position and does not carry sales quotas. The support to regional teams shall be through insights, analytics, commercial narratives, business cases, pipeline 
 governance, and customer-facing collateral that support successful go-to-market execution. 
 
 The Manager will be responsible for supporting the regional team in developing and executing the of Merchant Clouds commercialization strategy, accelerate product adoption and market expansion through close collaboration with Product, Services, and other internal stakeholders. This role is pivotal in ensuring that regional teams are equipped with the tools, insights, materials, and strategic needed to effectively position Merchant Cloud in the market. 
 
 - Highly organised and capable of engaging stakeholders globally to establish visibility into commercial pipelines and track go-to-market 
 performance. 
 - Skilled at solving complex business problems and developing compelling commercialisation strategies, value propositions, and go-to- 
 market materials. 
 - Experienced in tracking product roadmaps, developing business cases, and supporting investment decisions through data-driven analysis 
 and insights. 
 - Proven ability to manage pipeline reporting, commercial performance tracking, and growth initiatives that support product adoption and business outcomes. 
 - Passionate about enabling customer-facing teams through sales collateral, analytics, insights, and strategic narratives that enhance go-to-market effectiveness and customer engagement. We are looking for an energetic professional who is willing to jump into an ever-evolving team and hit the ground running. 
 
 The Manager will have a proven track record of working effectively in a team to drive successful outcomes, exceptional analytical skills, and a strong commercial mindset, along with impeccable communication skills to improve Merchant Cloud understanding and up take within the broader business. 
 
 More specifically, the candidate will be responsible for: 
 
 - Creating comprehensive commercialization packages and go to market materials for newly launched products and features. Strong 
 influencing skills through visualisation of data and ideas required. 
 - Partnering closely with the Services organization at regional level to support the identication and, structuring of potential upselling and cross selling opportunities within new accounts. 
 - Managing and continuously updating the sales pipeline across various regions for regional team s visibility regarding the ensure sustained 
 growth and prioritize high impact opportunities. 
 - Supporting the sales enablement initiatives of regional teams, delivering training, playbooks, and resources that keep teams hyper 
 focused on supporting the regional teams in their sales initiatives. 
 - Collaborating with regional teams and client facing groups to align commercialization strategies with local market needs. 
 - Leading KPI tracking and measuring the commercial impact of all launch and enablement efforts. 
 - Preparing business case inputs and analysis to support strategic investment and initiative decisions by regional teams 
 
 All About You 
 
 - Proven experience working in the Mastercard Services organization including BMI, Security Services, and Customer Acquisition and Engagement. 
 - In depth understanding and prior experience in the payments industry with a strong grasp of relevant market trends. 
 - Strong knowledge and experience in the Acquiring and Gateway ecosystem. 
 - Prior experience in dealing with the adoption of digital commerce solutions. 
 - A results-oriented professional able to drive outcomes, with proven experience in developing go to market strategies for new products and delivering scalable solutions. 
 - Entrepreneurial and commercial mindset able to adjust to changing demands of the market, customers, internal strategies, and build partnerships across the organization. 
 - Excellent communications and influencing skillset to support alignment of enablement strategies with business goals. 
 - Ability to lead cross functional and multi-location teams effectively. 
 - Organizational savviness to navigate a highly matrixed organization and resilience to thrive in a high pressure, goal-oriented environment. 
 - Strong problem solving and analytical skills, completely comfortable using data to support business cases and recommendations. 
 - Bachelor s degree required 
 - English fluency is mandatory.

description:
Job Description: Assistant Area Manager (Lab Water Sales and Service) Company: Borosil Scientific Limited
 Industry: Industrial Equipment / Scientific & Laboratory Equipment
 Location: Ahmedabad
 Experience Required: 6-10 Years
 Website: https://www.borosilscientific.com/ Gender: Male Only 
 About the Company Borosil Scientific Limited is a leading Indian manufacturer and supplier of laboratory glassware, scientific instruments, laboratory equipment and consumables, with over six decades of industry expertise. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of scientific solutions, including laboratory water purification systems, serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, healthcare and industrial laboratories. Borosil Scientific focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality products and technical solutions to customers across India and international markets. 
 Role Purpose The role will support and grow the Lab Water business in Pune and the assigned territory while ensuring that customers receive dependable support after the sale. The role involves understanding laboratory requirements, recommending suitable solutions, converting opportunities, coordinating installations and staying connected with customers throughout the life of the equipment. The person should be comfortable discussing business with decision-makers and equally willing to work with users and service colleagues at the customer site. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Territory Sales and Business Development Prepare and execute the annual territory plan for revenue, order intake, gross margin, new-account acquisition and installed-base expansion in line with the business plan. Map and develop target accounts across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CRO and CDMO organisations, healthcare and diagnostics, academic and government research, food and beverage, chemicals, environmental testing and other quality-control laboratories. Generate qualified opportunities through direct customer coverage, referrals, channel partners, exhibitions, seminars, application discussions and systematic follow-up of enquiries and leads. Understand the customer's application, required water grade, daily and peak demand, feed-water quality, available utilities, installation conditions, documentation expectations and lifecycle-cost considerations before recommending a solution. Prepare clear techno-commercial proposals and budgetary offers, negotiate within delegated authority and secure orders with appropriate price, margin, payment and delivery terms. Provide accurate technical and customer inputs to the commercial or tender-support team whenever their assistance is required. Maintain a healthy opportunity funnel, update CRM or sales trackers, submit accurate forecasts, and review conversion risks and recovery actions with the reporting manager. Monitor competitor activity, market pricing, application trends and customer feedback; provide structured inputs for product positioning, sales strategy and portfolio improvement. 
 2. Application and Solution Selling Position Type I, Type II, Type III and combined Type I and II systems according to the customer's analytical, life-science and general laboratory requirements. Explain relevant performance parameters such as conductivity, resistivity, total organic carbon, microbial and particle control, flow rate and storage capacity without making unsupported performance or compliance claims. Work with application, product and service specialists to select appropriate configurations involving reverse osmosis, electro-deionisation, UV or TOC options, ultrafiltration, storage and recirculation, dispensers, pre-treatment and point-of-use consumables. Conduct product presentations, site surveys, demonstrations and technical discussions for users, laboratory heads, QA and QC teams, engineering, procurement and senior decision-makers. Translate customer needs into an accurate bill of materials and clear scope of supply, including accessories, consumables, installation prerequisites and post-sale support. 
 3. Installation and After-Sales Service Plan and coordinate installations with the customer, logistics, service and product teams; confirm site readiness for feed water, drainage, power, space and operating conditions before the visit. Perform or supervise installation, commissioning, functional checks and user handover in accordance with approved procedures and the agreed scope. Provide user training on operation, routine care, water-quality monitoring, sanitisation, consumable replacement, alarm handling and good recordkeeping. Attend preventive-maintenance and breakdown calls, diagnose faults systematically and restore equipment safely within committed response and resolution timelines. Maintain complete service records, equipment history, installed-base data, visit reports, parts usage and closure evidence; obtain customer acknowledgement for completed work. Identify and convert opportunities for annual maintenance contracts, comprehensive service contracts where offered, consumables, cartridges, filters, spares, upgrades and replacement systems. Plan preventive-maintenance schedules and consumable replacement cycles, monitor contract renewals and support customers proactively to improve uptime and system performance. Escalate recurring, safety-related or technically complex failures with complete diagnostic information and coordinate corrective action with product, quality and engineering teams. Maintain service tools, test equipment and spare parts assigned to the territory, and ensure their safe custody, calibration status where applicable and optimum utilisation. 
 4. Customer and Commercial Management Act as the primary territory contact for Lab Water customers and coordinate internal ownership until enquiries, complaints, installations and service issues are closed. Build relationships with users, influencers, consultants, procurement teams and channel partners while maintaining professional, ethical and fact-based communication. Support timely collections, resolve commercial documentation gaps and manage credit exposure in coordination with finance and the reporting manager. Review customer feedback, repeat complaints and service trends; implement recovery actions and share improvement inputs with the relevant functions. 
 Candidate Profile Educational Qualifications Degree or diploma in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry, Biotechnology or Microbiology. 
 Experience Requirements Typically 6-10 years in laboratory-water purification, scientific instrumentation, analytical equipment, life-science equipment or a comparable technical B2B field role, including meaningful exposure to both sales and after-sales service. 
 Required Technical Knowledge Laboratory-water grades and applications, including Type I, Type II and Type III water. Purification technologies and components such as pre-treatment, reverse osmosis, deionisation or EDI, UV treatment, TOC reduction or monitoring, ultrafiltration, storage, recirculation, pumps, valves, sensors and dispensers. Water-quality parameters including conductivity, resistivity, TOC, microbial load, particles and endotoxin-sensitive applications. Basic electrical, electronic, plumbing and mechanical fault diagnosis; safe use of service tools and test equipment. Techno-commercial proposals, product demonstrations, CRM or pipeline management, service documentation and customer complaint handling. 
 Behavioural Competencies Customer focus with the ability to listen carefully, diagnose needs and take ownership through closure. Commercial judgement balanced with technical accuracy, serviceability and lifecycle value. Structured problem-solving and calm decision-making at customer sites. Clear written and verbal communication with laboratory users, technical teams and senior stakeholders. Planning discipline, follow-through, data-based reporting and accountability for commitments. Collaboration across sales, service, product, operations and support functions. Integrity, safety awareness, learning agility and willingness to remain hands-on in the field.

 About Mango Hill Hotels 
Mango Hill Hotels is a growing hospitality group with a portfolio of properties and brands serving leisure, business and event guests. We are building a dedicated in-house marketing team to strengthen our brand, deepen guest relationships and drive business growth across the portfolio. This role is one of the founding hires of that team. 
 Role Overview 
Mango Hill Hotels is looking for a creative, strategic and execution-oriented Assistant Manager - Brand Marketing to strengthen brand positioning, lead integrated campaigns and build compelling brand communication across its properties. 
The role leads brand strategy, content, creative direction, organic social media, PR & Communications, partnerships and brand activations, and the pre-launch and post-launch marketing of new properties. The ideal candidate combines sound marketing judgement with a strong creative eye, and balances strategy with hands-on execution.
This is a growth role, with a path to Manager as the team and portfolio expand. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Brand Strategy & Campaigns: Develop brand positioning, messaging and integrated marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives. Maintain brand guidelines and ensure consistent communication across brands, properties and customer touchpoints.
 Property Launch Marketing: Plan and run the pre-launch and post-launch marketing of each new property, from teaser campaigns, launch PR, content shoots and the opening event to the first 90 days of awareness and occupancy-building campaigns.
 Content & Storytelling: Build content strategies that showcase properties, destinations, guest experiences and offers. Plan content calendars and shape stories and copy that strengthen brand appeal.
 Creative Direction: Set creative direction and approve creative output for campaigns and collaterals. Step in to adapt assets, presentations and social creatives using Canva or similar tools when needed, while the Graphic Designer and external creative partners handle production.
 Social Media & Digital Collaboration: Guide organic social strategy and content planning. Work with Digital Marketing to amplify campaigns and align brand communication with acquisition and conversion goals.
 PR & Communications: Manage press releases, media relations, brand announcements and publicity opportunities, along with PR agency partners. Coordinate with Operations on reputation-sensitive communication.
 Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations: Plan and drive brand partnerships, events and activations that build visibility and support business priorities. Work with the wider marketing team on shared commercial focus areas.
 Property Marketing & Coordination: Work with property teams to understand business priorities, promote property-specific experiences and coordinate campaign and content requirements.
 Budget & Vendor Management: Own the brand marketing budget, including launch budgets, and manage creative agencies and external vendors for quality, timely delivery and efficient spend. 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related field. An MBA or PG in Marketing is preferred. 
6 -8 years of experience in brand marketing, preferably in hospitality, hotels, travel, tourism, lifestyle or other consumer-facing industries.

Handle common sales objections related to pricing, course selection, competition, timing, and decision-making. Use effective persuasion and negotiation techniques to move prospects through the admissions funnel. Create urgency and drive timely enrollment decisions without compromising the student experience.

Manage the sales pipeline and prioritize high-intent prospects. Ensure no qualified lead is missed due to delayed or inconsistent follow-up. Track individual performance against daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets

Highly confident and comfortable speaking with students and working professionals. Strong follow-up discipline and pipeline management skills. Target-driven and motivated by incentives and performance. Ability to understand customer needs and recommend the right solution. Comfortable working in a high-volume lead environment. Basic understanding of CRM systems and sales reporting. Strong ownership of individual sales targets and conversion numbers.

HTML Asset Support: Leverage working knowledge of HTML to build, troubleshoot, and refine email templates, landing pages, and form behaviors. Continuous Improvement: Monitor campaign performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend process and automation improvements to scale the marketing engine.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities AI Search, Digital Growth & Performance Marketing Manager Institution: ITS, Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh
 Department: Marketing & Admissions
 Designation: Manager AI Search, Digital Growth & Performance Marketing
 Reporting To: Director / Head of Marketing & Admissions / Management
 Location: Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Purpose To lead the institution’s digital growth strategy, performance marketing, AI-driven search visibility, and online lead generation initiatives. The role will focus on strengthening the digital presence of ITS Mohan Nagar across search engines, AI-powered search platforms, social media, and other digital channels to drive qualified student enquiries, improve admission conversions, and enhance the institution’s brand visibility. The incumbent will be responsible for integrating traditional digital marketing with emerging AI search technologies, data analytics, automation, and conversion optimisation to achieve measurable growth in admissions. 2. Key Roles and Responsibilities A. AI Search & Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) Develop and implement strategies to improve the visibility of ITS across AI-powered search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and other emerging answer engines. Implement Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), and traditional Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) strategies. Optimise institutional websites, course pages, FAQs, blogs, and other digital assets to improve discoverability across search engines and AI-driven platforms. Strengthen the institution’s online authority through high-quality content, structured data, credible backlinks, relevant citations, and accurate institutional information. Monitor brand mentions, search visibility, competitor positioning, and AI-generated recommendations relevant to higher education. Collaborate with content and web development teams to ensure accurate, engaging, and search-friendly content. B. Digital Growth & Performance Marketing Plan, execute, and optimise paid digital campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant advertising platforms. Develop performance marketing strategies to generate qualified leads for undergraduate, postgraduate, and other academic programmes. Manage campaign budgets, audience segmentation, keyword targeting, retargeting, and conversion tracking. Monitor key metrics, including Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Admission, Click-Through Rate (CTR), conversion rate, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and overall campaign ROI. Conduct A/B testing of advertisements, landing pages, creative formats, calls to action, and audience segments. Identify new digital acquisition channels and growth opportunities to increase admission enquiries while optimising marketing expenditure. Develop data-driven strategies to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs. C. SEO, Website & Conversion Rate Optimisation Manage the SEO strategy for the institutional website and individual programme pages. Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap assessments. Improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, user experience, landing-page performance, and conversion pathways. Plan and optimise dedicated landing pages for admission campaigns, events, webinars, and programme promotions. Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, website engagement, and lead-generation performance using analytics tools. Coordinate with web developers and content teams to implement technical improvements and SEO recommendations. D. Social Media & Digital Brand Management Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms. Strengthen the institution’s digital reputation through engaging content, student success stories, faculty achievements, campus activities, and academic initiatives. Coordinate with creative, video production, and content teams to develop high-performing digital assets. Monitor social media engagement, brand sentiment, online reviews, and audience feedback. Ensure consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, and communication across digital platforms. Develop strategies to increase organic reach, engagement, website traffic, and qualified admissions enquiries. E. Lead Management, CRM & Admissions Conversion Integrate digital campaigns with the institution’s CRM, admission management systems, and lead-tracking processes. Establish lead attribution and tracking mechanisms to identify the source, quality, and conversion status of enquiries. Collaborate with the Admissions Team to improve lead response time, follow-up efficiency, counselling appointments, and application conversions. Implement remarketing, email marketing, WhatsApp communication workflows, and marketing automation wherever appropriate. Analyse the complete lead funnel, from initial enquiry to application, admission, and enrolment. Recommend strategies to improve lead nurturing, reduce lead leakage, and increase the overall admission conversion ratio. Ensure proper consent, data protection, and responsible use of student and prospective applicant information. F. AI Tools, Automation & Marketing Analytics Identify and deploy suitable AI tools for campaign planning, content ideation, keyword analysis, reporting, audience insights, and marketing automation. Use analytics and attribution tools to evaluate campaign performance and support data-driven decision-making. Develop automated dashboards for monitoring campaign expenditure, lead generation, lead quality, conversion rates, and admission performance. Apply AI-assisted personalisation and predictive insights to improve audience targeting and campaign effectiveness. Ensure human review of AI-generated content for factual accuracy, institutional guidelines, originality, and brand consistency. Keep abreast of changes in search algorithms, AI search technologies, digital advertising platforms, and marketing best practices. G. Strategy, Budgeting & Reporting Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly digital marketing plans aligned with institutional admission targets. Prepare campaign budgets, media plans, forecasts, and performance projections. Submit regular reports to management on campaign performance, lead generation, marketing expenditure, and admissions outcomes. Conduct competitor benchmarking and identify opportunities to strengthen the institution’s digital positioning. Coordinate with internal departments, external agencies, vendors, and technology partners. Ensure timely execution of campaigns and adherence to approved budgets and institutional policies. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated against mutually agreed targets, including: Growth in qualified admission enquiries through digital channels. Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Reduction in Cost Per Qualified Lead and Cost Per Admission. Improvement in organic search visibility and website traffic. Growth in visibility across AI-driven search and answer platforms, assessed through appropriate visibility and referral indicators. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and overall digital marketing ROI. Website conversion rate and landing-page performance. Improvement in lead response, nurturing, and CRM tracking efficiency. Achievement of approved campaign budgets and admission targets. Timeliness, accuracy, and quality of management reports. Specific numerical targets will be finalised by management based on programme-wise admission requirements, approved budgets, historical performance, and the academic calendar. 4. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Computer Applications, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred. Relevant certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, SEO, Meta Ads, marketing automation, or performance marketing will be an advantage. 5. Experience Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, SEO, online lead generation, or digital growth. At least 2–3 years of experience in managing digital campaigns, budgets, and performance metrics independently. Experience in the education sector, particularly higher education and student admissions, will be preferred. Demonstrated experience in lead generation, paid media optimisation, conversion tracking, analytics, and CRM integration. Practical knowledge of AI search optimisation, GEO/AEO, and AI-assisted marketing tools will be an added advantage. 6. Technical Skills Required Paid Media: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, YouTube Ads and other relevant advertising platforms. Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Search Console and Looker Studio. SEO & AI Search: Keyword research, technical SEO, schema markup, content optimisation, GEO/AEO and search visibility monitoring. CRM & Automation: CRM platforms, lead management, email marketing, WhatsApp workflows and marketing automation. Conversion Optimisation: Landing-page optimisation, A/B testing, attribution modelling and funnel analysis. AI Tools: Practical use of generative AI tools for marketing research, content planning, analysis, and workflow automation. Reporting: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, budget tracking, and performance reporting. 7. Core Competencies Strategic thinking and growth-oriented execution. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Data-driven decision-making and budget management. Understanding of student acquisition and admission conversion funnels. Creativity combined with commercial and performance orientation. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deliver results within deadlines. Adaptability to evolving AI search technologies and digital marketing trends. 8. Working Relationships The incumbent will work closely with: Institutional Management and Marketing Leadership. Admissions and Counselling Teams. Website Development and IT Teams. Content, Creative, and Social Media Teams. External Digital Marketing Agencies and Technology Vendors. Academic Departments, as required for programme-specific campaigns. 9. General Responsibilities Maintain confidentiality of institutional information, campaign data, prospective student records, and marketing budgets. Ensure that all marketing communications are accurate, ethical, compliant with applicable advertising requirements, and consistent with institutional policies. Protect the institution’s brand reputation across digital platforms. Undertake any other marketing and digital growth responsibilities assigned by the competent authority in the interest of the institution. 10. Expected Outcome The successful candidate will establish a measurable, integrated digital growth framework for ITS Mohan Nagar, combining AI search visibility, performance marketing, SEO, analytics, and admissions funnel optimisation to strengthen institutional brand awareness, improve lead quality, increase admission conversions, and maximise the return on digital marketing investments.

title: AI Enablement
description:
1. Role Details Role AI Learning & Enablement Specialist (AI Trainer Corporate Enablement) Company INFOTEK Solutions Experience 4–7 years Salary Range Location Gurugram — 91springboard, Sector 21B or 9B, Cyber City Work Model Full-time, on-site - 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday) Reports To Head of Technology & Delivery Role Scope Individual contributor at the outset, with scope to build and lead a small team as the function scales. Coverage is the Gurugram operation. Onboarding Entity INFOTEK Solutions Notice Period Immediate to 30 days 2. Job Description INFOTEK Solutions is an IT and digital solutions organisation. Our delivery spans software and web development, digital marketing and content, design, functional consulting and process automation, and we manage websites and the full social media presence of the accounts in our care across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and Pinterest. A large volume of that work — content production, reporting, documentation, screening and MIS — is repetitive and currently manual. You will own the company-wide shift to AI-assisted working. That means auditing where every team loses hours, designing and delivering the training that closes the gap, building the prompt libraries and AI workflows teams use daily, setting the data-safety rules, and proving adoption with hard numbers reported to leadership every month. This is a hands-on builder-trainer role. You must be able to sit with a content writer, a designer, a recruiter or an accounts executive, watch them work for twenty minutes, and hand them a working AI workflow before you leave the desk. You will work in direct partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer — you prove workflows manually with users, they convert the proven ones into fully automated pipelines. 3. Roles and Responsibilities AI Opportunity Assessment Audit every function — Technology & Delivery, Digital Marketing, Design, Functional Consulting, HR, Finance and Operations — and document current manual workflows with time-per-task measurements. Maintain a scored use-case backlog (effort vs. impact vs. risk) and a rolling quarterly AI roadmap with department-level hour-saving targets. Hand high-volume, rules-clear cases to the Intelligent Automation Developer for full automation. Training Design and Delivery Design and own a four-tier curriculum: AI Foundations (how LLMs work, hallucination checking, verification discipline) to AI at Work (role-specific prompting, document and data workflows) to AI Power User (chaining, projects, tool integration) to AI Champion (peer-trainer certification). Deliver instructor-led workshops, hands-on labs, desk-side 1:1 coaching and floor-walk clinics. Run a separate leadership track for department heads and HODs: where AI fits their function, what to expect from their teams, how to review AI-assisted work, and how to sponsor adoption rather than merely permit it. Hold a standing monthly working session with each function head to review what their team automated, what stalled and what to attempt next. Build and maintain prompt libraries, SOPs, quick-reference cards, video micro-lessons and an internal AI knowledge base. Role-Specific AI Playbooks Content & SEO: blog outlining and drafting from the keyword bank, consistent brand voice across every account we publish for, meta titles and descriptions, content briefs, blog repurposing into social posts. Social Media: caption and hashtag generation per brand and platform, monthly calendar drafting, creative brief writing, comment and DM response drafting. Design: AI-assisted concept ideation, copy variants for creatives, image prompt writing and asset iteration. HR & Recruitment: JD drafting, resume screening and shortlisting summaries, interview question sets, candidate communication drafts. Delivery & Consulting: requirement documentation, BRD and SOW drafting, test-case generation, code documentation, project status summaries. Finance & Operations: MIS commentary, variance explanation, invoice and quotation drafting, vendor comparison summaries. Integration and Workflow Building Teach and demonstrate AI connected to the tools people already use — Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Google Analytics and Search Console, the applicant tracking system, and project and ticketing tools. Build low-code AI workflows live in sessions using Claude and ChatGPT projects, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Zapier/Make and Google Apps Script. Maintain a shared library of working workflows with clear “when to use this” documentation so solutions get reused, not rebuilt. Partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer Run joint discovery with the Intelligent Automation Developer: you surface the opportunity from the floor, they assess technical feasibility, and together you decide whether a case is solved by training people or by building an automation. Write the requirement for anything handed over for automation — current process, volume, exceptions, the approval step and the success measure — so the developer is not re-discovering the process from scratch. Validate every delivered automation with the users who will run it: confirm it works in real conditions, train them on it, and write the runbook entry in language they understand. Own the adoption of delivered automations, not just their delivery — an automation nobody uses counts as a failure against your targets, not the developer's. Governance and Policy Draft, publish and enforce the INFOTEK Solutions AI Acceptable Use Policy — data classification, what may never be pasted into public AI tools, client-confidentiality boundaries, mandatory human review points, and sign-off rules for anything client-facing or published. Deliver mandatory AI risk and data-privacy briefings; maintain completion records for audit and client compliance. Own AI tool licence management end to end: evaluation, allocation, onboarding, utilisation review, renewal and de-provisioning. Measurement and Reporting Maintain the AI adoption scorecard and publish a monthly impact dashboard to leadership with department-level breakdowns. Run the quarterly AI Champions programme — identify, certify and support power users in every department. Conduct 30- and 60-day post-training effectiveness reviews based on observed behaviour change, not feedback forms. 4. Required Skills 4–7 years in corporate L&D, enablement, technical training or digital transformation, with demonstrable daily hands-on AI use in real work. Strong practical command of at least two of Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini — including projects, custom instructions and document/data analysis. Genuine prompt engineering ability: structured framing, few-shot examples, output-format control, task decomposition and systematic verification. Instructional design fundamentals (ADDIE or equivalent) and practical 70-20-10 application. Proven end-to-end training programme ownership with adoption numbers you can show. Excellent facilitation — equally effective with a room of thirty and one sceptical person at a desk. Advanced Microsoft 365 including Excel; clear business writing for SOPs, policy and training content. Change-management capability — handling resistance, job-security anxiety and entrenched ways of working. Good to have: Power Automate / Copilot Studio / Power Apps exposure; LMS administration; basic Python or Google Apps Script; DPDP Act 2023 and ISO/IEC 42001 awareness; agency, IT services or BPO background; AI-900, MS-4004 or Google Cloud Generative AI certification.
