title: AI Enablement
description:
1. Role Details Role AI Learning & Enablement Specialist (AI Trainer Corporate Enablement) Company INFOTEK Solutions Experience 4–7 years Salary Range Location Gurugram — 91springboard, Sector 21B or 9B, Cyber City Work Model Full-time, on-site - 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday) Reports To Head of Technology & Delivery Role Scope Individual contributor at the outset, with scope to build and lead a small team as the function scales. Coverage is the Gurugram operation. Onboarding Entity INFOTEK Solutions Notice Period Immediate to 30 days 2. Job Description INFOTEK Solutions is an IT and digital solutions organisation. Our delivery spans software and web development, digital marketing and content, design, functional consulting and process automation, and we manage websites and the full social media presence of the accounts in our care across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and Pinterest. A large volume of that work — content production, reporting, documentation, screening and MIS — is repetitive and currently manual. You will own the company-wide shift to AI-assisted working. That means auditing where every team loses hours, designing and delivering the training that closes the gap, building the prompt libraries and AI workflows teams use daily, setting the data-safety rules, and proving adoption with hard numbers reported to leadership every month. This is a hands-on builder-trainer role. You must be able to sit with a content writer, a designer, a recruiter or an accounts executive, watch them work for twenty minutes, and hand them a working AI workflow before you leave the desk. You will work in direct partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer — you prove workflows manually with users, they convert the proven ones into fully automated pipelines. 3. Roles and Responsibilities AI Opportunity Assessment Audit every function — Technology & Delivery, Digital Marketing, Design, Functional Consulting, HR, Finance and Operations — and document current manual workflows with time-per-task measurements. Maintain a scored use-case backlog (effort vs. impact vs. risk) and a rolling quarterly AI roadmap with department-level hour-saving targets. Hand high-volume, rules-clear cases to the Intelligent Automation Developer for full automation. Training Design and Delivery Design and own a four-tier curriculum: AI Foundations (how LLMs work, hallucination checking, verification discipline) to AI at Work (role-specific prompting, document and data workflows) to AI Power User (chaining, projects, tool integration) to AI Champion (peer-trainer certification). Deliver instructor-led workshops, hands-on labs, desk-side 1:1 coaching and floor-walk clinics. Run a separate leadership track for department heads and HODs: where AI fits their function, what to expect from their teams, how to review AI-assisted work, and how to sponsor adoption rather than merely permit it. Hold a standing monthly working session with each function head to review what their team automated, what stalled and what to attempt next. Build and maintain prompt libraries, SOPs, quick-reference cards, video micro-lessons and an internal AI knowledge base. Role-Specific AI Playbooks Content & SEO: blog outlining and drafting from the keyword bank, consistent brand voice across every account we publish for, meta titles and descriptions, content briefs, blog repurposing into social posts. Social Media: caption and hashtag generation per brand and platform, monthly calendar drafting, creative brief writing, comment and DM response drafting. Design: AI-assisted concept ideation, copy variants for creatives, image prompt writing and asset iteration. HR & Recruitment: JD drafting, resume screening and shortlisting summaries, interview question sets, candidate communication drafts. Delivery & Consulting: requirement documentation, BRD and SOW drafting, test-case generation, code documentation, project status summaries. Finance & Operations: MIS commentary, variance explanation, invoice and quotation drafting, vendor comparison summaries. Integration and Workflow Building Teach and demonstrate AI connected to the tools people already use — Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Google Analytics and Search Console, the applicant tracking system, and project and ticketing tools. Build low-code AI workflows live in sessions using Claude and ChatGPT projects, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Zapier/Make and Google Apps Script. Maintain a shared library of working workflows with clear “when to use this” documentation so solutions get reused, not rebuilt. Partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer Run joint discovery with the Intelligent Automation Developer: you surface the opportunity from the floor, they assess technical feasibility, and together you decide whether a case is solved by training people or by building an automation. Write the requirement for anything handed over for automation — current process, volume, exceptions, the approval step and the success measure — so the developer is not re-discovering the process from scratch. Validate every delivered automation with the users who will run it: confirm it works in real conditions, train them on it, and write the runbook entry in language they understand. Own the adoption of delivered automations, not just their delivery — an automation nobody uses counts as a failure against your targets, not the developer's. Governance and Policy Draft, publish and enforce the INFOTEK Solutions AI Acceptable Use Policy — data classification, what may never be pasted into public AI tools, client-confidentiality boundaries, mandatory human review points, and sign-off rules for anything client-facing or published. Deliver mandatory AI risk and data-privacy briefings; maintain completion records for audit and client compliance. Own AI tool licence management end to end: evaluation, allocation, onboarding, utilisation review, renewal and de-provisioning. Measurement and Reporting Maintain the AI adoption scorecard and publish a monthly impact dashboard to leadership with department-level breakdowns. Run the quarterly AI Champions programme — identify, certify and support power users in every department. Conduct 30- and 60-day post-training effectiveness reviews based on observed behaviour change, not feedback forms. 4. Required Skills 4–7 years in corporate L&D, enablement, technical training or digital transformation, with demonstrable daily hands-on AI use in real work. Strong practical command of at least two of Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini — including projects, custom instructions and document/data analysis. Genuine prompt engineering ability: structured framing, few-shot examples, output-format control, task decomposition and systematic verification. Instructional design fundamentals (ADDIE or equivalent) and practical 70-20-10 application. Proven end-to-end training programme ownership with adoption numbers you can show. Excellent facilitation — equally effective with a room of thirty and one sceptical person at a desk. Advanced Microsoft 365 including Excel; clear business writing for SOPs, policy and training content. Change-management capability — handling resistance, job-security anxiety and entrenched ways of working. Good to have: Power Automate / Copilot Studio / Power Apps exposure; LMS administration; basic Python or Google Apps Script; DPDP Act 2023 and ISO/IEC 42001 awareness; agency, IT services or BPO background; AI-900, MS-4004 or Google Cloud Generative AI certification.

description:
Job Description Position: Billing & Revenue Assurance Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented and process-driven professional to manage end-to-end customer and intercompany billing activities, ensure compliance with applicable local tax regulations, support revenue assurance, and drive continuous process improvements. The role will involve close coordination with Operations, Project, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate, timely, and complete billing across entities and geographies. Key Responsibilities Billing & Revenue Management Manage the end-to-end billing process for customer and intercompany transactions, ensuring timely and accurate invoice generation and submission. Coordinate with Operations, Project, and Finance teams to validate billing inputs, contracts, supporting documentation, and other relevant data. Ensure completeness and accuracy of billing data and proactively identify and resolve billing discrepancies. Support the Revenue Assurance function in ensuring billing completeness and minimizing revenue leakage. Prepare and present periodic billing, revenue, and submission reports to relevant stakeholders. Monitor billing timelines and ensure adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal controls. Tax & Compliance Ensure invoices comply with applicable local tax requirements, including GST, VAT, and other indirect taxes, as relevant to respective entities and jurisdictions. Validate tax treatment and identify potential compliance gaps or conflicts that may result in tax exposure or losses. Ensure billing transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and comply with internal policies and local statutory requirements. Support internal and external audits by providing billing-related information, documentation, reconciliations, and explanations. Respond to audit queries relating to customer and intercompany billing in a timely and accurate manner. Intercompany Accounting & Reconciliation Prepare and perform monthly intercompany reconciliations with respective intercompany partners. Investigate and resolve intercompany mismatches, unreconciled balances, and transaction differences. Coordinate with relevant entities and stakeholders to ensure timely closure of intercompany discrepancies. Maintain appropriate supporting documentation and ensure reconciliation controls are consistently followed. Handle transactions involving foreign currencies and understand the impact of foreign exchange on billing and reconciliation activities. Process Improvement & Automation Identify opportunities to improve billing processes, controls, and reporting mechanisms. Drive standardization and automation initiatives to improve billing efficiency, accuracy, and turnaround time. Identify repetitive or manual activities and recommend technology-enabled solutions. Develop and maintain effective process controls to reduce errors, billing delays, and revenue leakage. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the billing and revenue assurance function. Key Skills & Competencies Strong understanding of end-to-end billing processes and revenue assurance concepts. Knowledge of customer and intercompany transactions and reconciliations. Good understanding of GST, VAT, and other applicable indirect tax requirements. Working knowledge of foreign-currency transactions and related accounting considerations. Strong analytical and reconciliation skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams across different geographies. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines. Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment. Strong process orientation with a continuous-improvement mindset. Relevant experience in billing, revenue assurance, finance operations, accounts receivable, intercompany accounting, or a related function. Experience working with multiple entities, geographies, currencies, and tax jurisdictions would be an advantage. Proficiency in MS Excel and experience with ERP/finance systems is preferred. Key Attributes The ideal candidate will demonstrate: Attention to detail Ensures accuracy and completeness across billing and reconciliation activities. title: AI Enablement
description:
1. Role Details Role AI Learning & Enablement Specialist (AI Trainer Corporate Enablement) Company INFOTEK Solutions Experience 4–7 years Salary Range Location Gurugram — 91springboard, Sector 21B or 9B, Cyber City Work Model Full-time, on-site - 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday) Reports To Head of Technology & Delivery Role Scope Individual contributor at the outset, with scope to build and lead a small team as the function scales. Coverage is the Gurugram operation. Onboarding Entity INFOTEK Solutions Notice Period Immediate to 30 days 2. Job Description INFOTEK Solutions is an IT and digital solutions organisation. Our delivery spans software and web development, digital marketing and content, design, functional consulting and process automation, and we manage websites and the full social media presence of the accounts in our care across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and Pinterest. A large volume of that work — content production, reporting, documentation, screening and MIS — is repetitive and currently manual. You will own the company-wide shift to AI-assisted working. That means auditing where every team loses hours, designing and delivering the training that closes the gap, building the prompt libraries and AI workflows teams use daily, setting the data-safety rules, and proving adoption with hard numbers reported to leadership every month. This is a hands-on builder-trainer role. You must be able to sit with a content writer, a designer, a recruiter or an accounts executive, watch them work for twenty minutes, and hand them a working AI workflow before you leave the desk. You will work in direct partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer — you prove workflows manually with users, they convert the proven ones into fully automated pipelines. 3. Roles and Responsibilities AI Opportunity Assessment Audit every function — Technology & Delivery, Digital Marketing, Design, Functional Consulting, HR, Finance and Operations — and document current manual workflows with time-per-task measurements. Maintain a scored use-case backlog (effort vs. impact vs. risk) and a rolling quarterly AI roadmap with department-level hour-saving targets. Hand high-volume, rules-clear cases to the Intelligent Automation Developer for full automation. Training Design and Delivery Design and own a four-tier curriculum: AI Foundations (how LLMs work, hallucination checking, verification discipline) to AI at Work (role-specific prompting, document and data workflows) to AI Power User (chaining, projects, tool integration) to AI Champion (peer-trainer certification). Deliver instructor-led workshops, hands-on labs, desk-side 1:1 coaching and floor-walk clinics. Run a separate leadership track for department heads and HODs: where AI fits their function, what to expect from their teams, how to review AI-assisted work, and how to sponsor adoption rather than merely permit it. Hold a standing monthly working session with each function head to review what their team automated, what stalled and what to attempt next. Build and maintain prompt libraries, SOPs, quick-reference cards, video micro-lessons and an internal AI knowledge base. Role-Specific AI Playbooks Content & SEO: blog outlining and drafting from the keyword bank, consistent brand voice across every account we publish for, meta titles and descriptions, content briefs, blog repurposing into social posts. Social Media: caption and hashtag generation per brand and platform, monthly calendar drafting, creative brief writing, comment and DM response drafting. Design: AI-assisted concept ideation, copy variants for creatives, image prompt writing and asset iteration. HR & Recruitment: JD drafting, resume screening and shortlisting summaries, interview question sets, candidate communication drafts. Delivery & Consulting: requirement documentation, BRD and SOW drafting, test-case generation, code documentation, project status summaries. Finance & Operations: MIS commentary, variance explanation, invoice and quotation drafting, vendor comparison summaries. Integration and Workflow Building Teach and demonstrate AI connected to the tools people already use — Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Google Analytics and Search Console, the applicant tracking system, and project and ticketing tools. Build low-code AI workflows live in sessions using Claude and ChatGPT projects, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Zapier/Make and Google Apps Script. Maintain a shared library of working workflows with clear “when to use this” documentation so solutions get reused, not rebuilt. Partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer Run joint discovery with the Intelligent Automation Developer: you surface the opportunity from the floor, they assess technical feasibility, and together you decide whether a case is solved by training people or by building an automation. Write the requirement for anything handed over for automation — current process, volume, exceptions, the approval step and the success measure — so the developer is not re-discovering the process from scratch. Validate every delivered automation with the users who will run it: confirm it works in real conditions, train them on it, and write the runbook entry in language they understand. Own the adoption of delivered automations, not just their delivery — an automation nobody uses counts as a failure against your targets, not the developer's. Governance and Policy Draft, publish and enforce the INFOTEK Solutions AI Acceptable Use Policy — data classification, what may never be pasted into public AI tools, client-confidentiality boundaries, mandatory human review points, and sign-off rules for anything client-facing or published. Deliver mandatory AI risk and data-privacy briefings; maintain completion records for audit and client compliance. Own AI tool licence management end to end: evaluation, allocation, onboarding, utilisation review, renewal and de-provisioning. Measurement and Reporting Maintain the AI adoption scorecard and publish a monthly impact dashboard to leadership with department-level breakdowns. Run the quarterly AI Champions programme — identify, certify and support power users in every department. Conduct 30- and 60-day post-training effectiveness reviews based on observed behaviour change, not feedback forms. 4. Required Skills 4–7 years in corporate L&D, enablement, technical training or digital transformation, with demonstrable daily hands-on AI use in real work. Strong practical command of at least two of Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini — including projects, custom instructions and document/data analysis. Genuine prompt engineering ability: structured framing, few-shot examples, output-format control, task decomposition and systematic verification. Instructional design fundamentals (ADDIE or equivalent) and practical 70-20-10 application. Proven end-to-end training programme ownership with adoption numbers you can show. Excellent facilitation — equally effective with a room of thirty and one sceptical person at a desk. Advanced Microsoft 365 including Excel; clear business writing for SOPs, policy and training content. Change-management capability — handling resistance, job-security anxiety and entrenched ways of working. Good to have: Power Automate / Copilot Studio / Power Apps exposure; LMS administration; basic Python or Google Apps Script; DPDP Act 2023 and ISO/IEC 42001 awareness; agency, IT services or BPO background; AI-900, MS-4004 or Google Cloud Generative AI certification.

description:
Job Description: Finance Executive Zoho Books & Payroll 
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Employment Type: Full-Time (Work from Office)
 Industry: IT Services / Software Development
 Experience: 3 - 6 Years Job Location: Coimbatore - Tamil Nadu 
 Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Finance Executive to manage the company's accounting operations using Zoho Books. The role involves maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day accounting activities, handling payroll processing and validation, preparing financial reports, and supporting management with financial insights. 
 The ideal candidate must have excellent hands-on experience in Zoho Books, strong accounting knowledge, exceptional numerical and analytical skills, and practical experience in payroll processing and validation. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting Operations Manage day-to-day accounting transactions using Zoho Books. Record sales invoices, customer receipts, vendor bills, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Maintain Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP). Perform monthly bank, credit card, vendor, and customer reconciliations. Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules. Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables, payables, and working capital requirements. Ensure accurate classification and recording of all financial transactions. 2. Zoho Books Management Demonstrate strong hands-on expertise in Zoho Books and manage accounting activities independently. Maintain the Chart of Accounts, tax settings, opening balances, and accounting records. Generate financial reports and dashboards. Ensure data accuracy, proper ledger maintenance, and appropriate accounting controls. Identify and resolve discrepancies in accounting records. Improve accounting workflows and streamline routine processes within Zoho Books. 3. Payroll Processing & Validation Independently manage monthly payroll processing and validate payroll inputs before finalization. Verify employee attendance, leave records, salary inputs, incentives, reimbursements, and deductions. Validate salary calculations, new joiners, employee exits, salary revisions, and full-and-final settlements. Check payroll reports for calculation errors, duplicate entries, missing information, and unusual month-on-month variations. Reconcile payroll data with employee records, previous-month payroll, and actual salary payments. Coordinate with HR to resolve discrepancies in employee master data and salary inputs. Ensure payroll summaries are accurate and approved before salary disbursement. Record salary expenses, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll liabilities accurately in Zoho Books. 4. Financial Reporting & MIS Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Generate Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow statements, and MIS reports. Analyze expenses, financial performance, and variances. Provide management with accurate financial analysis and business insights. Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. Ensure timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closure. 5. Taxation, Compliance & Audit Coordination Maintain accurate accounting records to support GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements. Assist in GST return preparation, reconciliations, and supporting documentation. Coordinate with the dedicated payroll compliance team for statutory deductions, compliance requirements, and related filings. Prepare schedules and documentation for statutory and tax audits. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and relevant stakeholders. Ensure financial records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready. 6. Process Improvement & Internal Controls Develop and maintain accounting Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Improve accounting processes, reconciliation procedures, and internal financial controls. Maintain proper financial documentation and records. Recommend improvements to reduce accounting errors and improve operational efficiency. 
 Required Qualifications B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or an equivalent qualification. 3-6 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance operations. Excellent hands-on experience with Zoho Books is mandatory. Practical experience in payroll processing and payroll validation. Strong understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, and financial reporting. Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian statutory compliance requirements. Proficiency in MS Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, and lookup functions. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in IT Services, Software Development, SaaS, or Consulting. Familiarity with project-based billing and service accounting. Experience in monthly financial closure, MIS reporting, and audit coordination. 
 Key Skills Zoho Books Advanced Practical Knowledge Financial Accounting & Bookkeeping Payroll Processing & Validation Bank and Ledger Reconciliation Accounts Payable & Receivable Financial Reporting & MIS GST & TDS Knowledge Advanced MS Excel Strong Numerical and Analytical Skills Attention to Detail and Problem-Solving Confidentiality and Financial Discipline 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries in Zoho Books. Timely monthly account closure and financial reporting. Accuracy of payroll inputs, calculations, and payroll summaries. Timely completion of bank and ledger reconciliations. Accuracy of financial reports and management information. Prompt identification and resolution of accounting and payroll discrepancies. 
 Ideal Candidate: A numbers-oriented finance professional with 45 years of experience, excellent Zoho Books expertise, and the ability to independently manage accounting operations, payroll processing and validation, reconciliations, and financial reporting while coordinating with the dedicated payroll team for statutory compliance.

Job Title: Junior Specialist - Accounts Payable Location: Pune (Hybrid working) 
 
 Job Summary 
 The Accounts Payable Junior Specialist will be part of the Global Finance Shared Service Center and responsible for end-to-end Accounts Payable activities for global entities. The role requires strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes, accounting fundamentals, Procure-to-Pay (P2P) activities, and experience working in a global invoice processing environment. The individual will manage PO and Non-PO invoice processing, validating invoice details, ensuring accurate accounting entries, vendor payments, reconciliations and SAP-based accounting transactions while ensuring compliance with company policies and statutory regulations. Verify purchase orders, goods receipts, invoice details, payment terms, and vendor information before posting. Perform invoice posting in SAP, ensuring accurate GL coding, cost center allocation, and accounting treatment. Process domestic, international, and intercompany invoices for global entities. Handle invoice exceptions, discrepancies, blocked invoices, and rejected cases, coordinating with relevant stakeholders for resolution. Manage recurring entries, credit notes, debit notes, and reversal postings. Understand basic accounting principles, including debit and credit entries and the accounting impact of vendor transactions. Perform vendor account reconciliations and open-item management, including investigation and resolution of outstanding items. Respond to vendor and internal stakeholder queries related to invoice status, payment status, discrepancies, and pending approvals. Open item management Understand accounting impacts of vendor postings, including debit and credit entries. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails. Ensure adherence to SOPs and internal controls. Work on Ad-Hoc requests. 
 
 Experience, Skills Qualifications

Strong understanding experience on entire P2P process. Must be well organized, detail oriented and multitasking. Good knowledge of MS Office - Word, excel and PowerPoint. title: Sr Accountant
description:
Job Description 
 A hands-on senior accounting personnel to manage the outsourced finance and accounting functions for our entity in India. In this role, he/she will be responsible for working closely with our outsourcing partner, Genpact to ensure all transactional activities and treasury related tasks are accurately and efficiently performed. He/She will also be responsible for managing the local regulatory reporting and other statutory reporting and foreign currency reporting. He/She will report to the Associate Director, Controller Asia and Greater China and will work closely with cross-functional teams. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Financial Operations and Controllership 
 Oversee day-to-day finance and accounting operations for the assigned entities, including managing outsourced service providers to ensure timely and accurate processing of transactional accounting activities. Provide overall controllership oversight, ensuring financial accuracy, integrity, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Manage the Record-to-Report (RTR) process, including General Ledger management, period-end close activities, and balance sheet reconciliations through BlackLine. Ensure completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of financial records and proper documentation of all financial transactions. 
 
 Financial Reporting 
 Manage month-end and year-end close processes and ensure financial reporting is prepared in accordance with US GAAP, Group reporting standards, and local GAAP requirements. Prepare and review monthly financial statements, including PL and Balance Sheet reporting, and provide financial analysis and insights to management. Monitor and analyze financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
 
 Treasury and Cash Management 
 Manage treasury functions including cash management, bank relationships, and cash flow forecasting. Oversee foreign currency reporting and treasury-related activities. Manage banking operations and resolve banking-related matters. 
 
 Order-to-Cash and Working Capital Management 
 Oversee Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) related processes including invoicing, customer credit management, collections, and accounts receivable. Support revenue recognition processes and ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards. Support working capital optimization through effective cash collection and cost control. 
 
 Procure-to-Pay and Operational Finance 
 Oversee Accounts Payable and TE processes, including vendor payments and expense reimbursements. Ensure proper management of invoicing, payments, and intercompany transactions. 
 
 Tax and Statutory Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with all local statutory and regulatory reporting requirements in India, including timely filing of statutory returns. Support Tax payments and Audit support in coordination with TAX department.

title: Sr Transactions Manager
description:
The role 
 Were looking for a Manager, Transaction Management, to support some of the worlds largest companies(client s) across the world covering Asia (APAC) , Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and other parts of the globe. You ll be based in Gurugram, India. 

 What this job involves 
 Leading strategy, not just transactions. This is a strategic leadership role. Youll turn portfolio data and market insight into advice that shapes how some of the worlds largest companies use real estate across Globally. Youll own the delivery of complex transactions, but your biggest impact comes from setting account direction, advising senior stakeholders and building the teams, governance and analytics that keep the platform consistent across regions. The role blends hands-on ownership, team leadership and enterprise-level influence. Youll coordinate medium-complex transactions independently, lead high-complexity transactions end to end, and set the strategic agenda for multi-service accounts that span regions. 

 Key responsibilities 
 Lead transactions end to end: Independently coordinate medium-complex transactions and lead high-complexity ones, including lease acquisitions, renewals and terminations, with full delivery accountability. Direct broker and market strategy: Negotiate with brokers, challenge market inputs and direct strategy across the account portfolio to secure favorable positions. Uphold standards: Make sure account workflows, approval protocols and documentation standards are followed across the team, and that trackers, approval packs, lease inputs and critical dates are accurate. Present financial analysis: Present analyses to clients, including NPV, cash flow and PL models, with clear strategic and commercial implications. Manage RFPs and close actions: Direct RFP strategy and commercial positioning across the portfolio, coordinating legal and finance input through to award, and close open actions within agreed timelines. 

 Client and stakeholder partnership 
 Set account direction: Use deep knowledge of each clients business and portfolio to shape account strategy and hold relationship oversight across accounts. Coordinate stakeholders: Lead internal and external broker meetings and manage stakeholder expectations across regions. Lead workshops and strategic sessions, and lead client communication and presentations so expectations are managed directly. Anticipate and respond: Respond with urgency and flag risks before they affect delivery. Grow account value: Develop strategic solutions that strengthen account value and set the growth agenda across multi-service accounts. 

 Strategic advisory and platform governance 
 Portfolio strategy: Help define and deliver medium portfolio strategy advisory services to clients, providing strategic insights and recommendations that align with their business objectives Lead advisory on complex decisions: Advise senior client decision-makers on portfolio options, with clear rationale, risk assessment and recommendations. Set governance standards: Set governance and reporting standards, including quarterly business reviews and KPI reviews, for consistent delivery across the platform. Drive process improvement: Turn stakeholder feedback into workflow changes, redesign account workflows and embed the revised process across the team. Partner across service lines: Coordinate all service lines to deliver integrated, multi-service client solutions. 

 Digital, data and innovation 
 Champion the toolset: Use RFFT, MAPIT, Blackbird, SmartSheet, PAT, Excel, AI, dashboards and JLL GPT to improve speed, accuracy and consistency, and set the example for your team. Protect data quality: Maintain clean, structured data across trackers, reports and documentation. Automate: Identify manual, repetitive tasks, then build and deploy automation that measurably reduces effort and turnaround time. Standardize: Standardize templates and recurring deliverables as best practice for the team. 

 Culture and brand 
 Lead and develop teams: Lead teams of more than five people for extended periods (six months or more), organize day-to-day workload, mentor junior colleagues, and lead learning, development and knowledge management. Collaborate: Work effectively with peers, account teams, brokers and cross-functional teams across regions. Represent JLL: Demonstrate integrity, confidentiality and responsible ownership, and represent JLL with executive presence in senior client and leadership forums. 

 How youll work 
 Relationship management: Youll build strong, lasting relationships and help clients navigate the JLL delivery platform efficiently. Youll understand account profitability and shape account plans that meet revenue, performance and client service targets. Commercial acumen: Youll prepare and challenge financial analysis, contribute to client budget forecasting and forecast revenue, initiating and closing projects to meet monthly cashflow plans. Youll use technology and new products within JLL to deliver next-generation benefits for clients. Operating across regions: Can you see the bigger picture Can you juggle regional delivery that aligns to a global strategy As the Transaction Management lead supporting EMEA, APAC and Global accounts, youll bring each regions successes and risks to the forefront, offer practical solutions, and guide clients and teams toward proven processes and portfolio strategies.

title: Sr Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Cvent is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team in Gurugram, India to help build and maintain the platform behind our event and hospitality SaaS business. This is a high impact engineering role for a person who thrives at: solving complex platform challenges, partnering with our internal technology teams to support Cvent s customers, and executing complex technical infrastructure changes with minimal to no disruption In this role you will help keep infrastructure hosted on on-premises operational while looking at strategies to migrate said infrastructure into Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments along with Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud environments as needed. You will drive the evolution of secure, scalable infrastructure that supports both customer-facing applications and internal platforms our engineering teams depend on to build and operate software at scale. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Build and improve internal infrastructure platforms with a focus to migrate to cloud environments. Develop automation driven by self-service workflows that accelerate delivery of infrastructure while strengthening governance and reliability. Bring observability maturity to hybrid environments using Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent across both cloud and on-premises workloads during the migration window. Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation alongside an experienced global team and contribute to incident response with clear root-cause analysis. Partner closely with Security, Database, Enterprise Services, and SRE teams across India, UK, US, and Canada to solve complex cross-functional infrastructure challenges. Provide senior technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and hands-on problem solving. Identify and implement practical uses of generative AI to improve internal tooling, automation, and speed of execution. 
 
 How You Will Spend Your Time 
 This role drives technical change partnering with technical leaders across a worldwide team. A typical allocation is: 50% hands on engineering and automation development. 25% code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance. 25% operational support and partnership with internal customers. 
 
 Heres What You Need 
 Must-Have 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or Security Engineering. Strong experience building automation, CI/CD pipelines (via Github Actions, Jenkins, and/or ArgoCD), configuration management, and infrastructure tooling using Python, TypeScript, or similar languages. Proven experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure in high-scale, multi-account, multi-region production environments. Experience with configuration management and systems automation using tools such as AWS Systems Manager, Chef, Ansible, Ansible AWX, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite. Experience supporting Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky, Amazon, CentOS) environments in enterprise-scale infrastructure Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with other engineers, stakeholders, and technical leadership. Nice-to-Have Hands-on experience with serverless architectures and AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, and related platform components. Strong experience building observability solutions in Datadog, migrating from other platforms such as Checkmk, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Splunk, Nagios, and/or Zabbix.

title: Assistant Area Manager
description:
Job Description: Assistant Area Manager (Lab Water Sales and Service) Company: Borosil Scientific Limited
 Industry: Industrial Equipment / Scientific & Laboratory Equipment
 Location: Ahmedabad
 Experience Required: 6-10 Years
 Website: https://www.borosilscientific.com/ Gender: Male Only 
 About the Company Borosil Scientific Limited is a leading Indian manufacturer and supplier of laboratory glassware, scientific instruments, laboratory equipment and consumables, with over six decades of industry expertise. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of scientific solutions, including laboratory water purification systems, serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, healthcare and industrial laboratories. Borosil Scientific focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality products and technical solutions to customers across India and international markets. 
 Role Purpose The role will support and grow the Lab Water business in Pune and the assigned territory while ensuring that customers receive dependable support after the sale. The role involves understanding laboratory requirements, recommending suitable solutions, converting opportunities, coordinating installations and staying connected with customers throughout the life of the equipment. The person should be comfortable discussing business with decision-makers and equally willing to work with users and service colleagues at the customer site. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Territory Sales and Business Development Prepare and execute the annual territory plan for revenue, order intake, gross margin, new-account acquisition and installed-base expansion in line with the business plan. Map and develop target accounts across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CRO and CDMO organisations, healthcare and diagnostics, academic and government research, food and beverage, chemicals, environmental testing and other quality-control laboratories. Generate qualified opportunities through direct customer coverage, referrals, channel partners, exhibitions, seminars, application discussions and systematic follow-up of enquiries and leads. Understand the customer's application, required water grade, daily and peak demand, feed-water quality, available utilities, installation conditions, documentation expectations and lifecycle-cost considerations before recommending a solution. Prepare clear techno-commercial proposals and budgetary offers, negotiate within delegated authority and secure orders with appropriate price, margin, payment and delivery terms. Provide accurate technical and customer inputs to the commercial or tender-support team whenever their assistance is required. Maintain a healthy opportunity funnel, update CRM or sales trackers, submit accurate forecasts, and review conversion risks and recovery actions with the reporting manager. Monitor competitor activity, market pricing, application trends and customer feedback; provide structured inputs for product positioning, sales strategy and portfolio improvement. 
 2. Application and Solution Selling Position Type I, Type II, Type III and combined Type I and II systems according to the customer's analytical, life-science and general laboratory requirements. Explain relevant performance parameters such as conductivity, resistivity, total organic carbon, microbial and particle control, flow rate and storage capacity without making unsupported performance or compliance claims. Work with application, product and service specialists to select appropriate configurations involving reverse osmosis, electro-deionisation, UV or TOC options, ultrafiltration, storage and recirculation, dispensers, pre-treatment and point-of-use consumables. Conduct product presentations, site surveys, demonstrations and technical discussions for users, laboratory heads, QA and QC teams, engineering, procurement and senior decision-makers. Translate customer needs into an accurate bill of materials and clear scope of supply, including accessories, consumables, installation prerequisites and post-sale support. 
 3. Installation and After-Sales Service Plan and coordinate installations with the customer, logistics, service and product teams; confirm site readiness for feed water, drainage, power, space and operating conditions before the visit. Perform or supervise installation, commissioning, functional checks and user handover in accordance with approved procedures and the agreed scope. Provide user training on operation, routine care, water-quality monitoring, sanitisation, consumable replacement, alarm handling and good recordkeeping. Attend preventive-maintenance and breakdown calls, diagnose faults systematically and restore equipment safely within committed response and resolution timelines. Maintain complete service records, equipment history, installed-base data, visit reports, parts usage and closure evidence; obtain customer acknowledgement for completed work. Identify and convert opportunities for annual maintenance contracts, comprehensive service contracts where offered, consumables, cartridges, filters, spares, upgrades and replacement systems. Plan preventive-maintenance schedules and consumable replacement cycles, monitor contract renewals and support customers proactively to improve uptime and system performance. Escalate recurring, safety-related or technically complex failures with complete diagnostic information and coordinate corrective action with product, quality and engineering teams. Maintain service tools, test equipment and spare parts assigned to the territory, and ensure their safe custody, calibration status where applicable and optimum utilisation. 
 4. Customer and Commercial Management Act as the primary territory contact for Lab Water customers and coordinate internal ownership until enquiries, complaints, installations and service issues are closed. Build relationships with users, influencers, consultants, procurement teams and channel partners while maintaining professional, ethical and fact-based communication. Support timely collections, resolve commercial documentation gaps and manage credit exposure in coordination with finance and the reporting manager. Review customer feedback, repeat complaints and service trends; implement recovery actions and share improvement inputs with the relevant functions. 
 Candidate Profile Educational Qualifications Degree or diploma in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry, Biotechnology or Microbiology. 
 Experience Requirements Typically 6-10 years in laboratory-water purification, scientific instrumentation, analytical equipment, life-science equipment or a comparable technical B2B field role, including meaningful exposure to both sales and after-sales service. 
 Required Technical Knowledge Laboratory-water grades and applications, including Type I, Type II and Type III water. Purification technologies and components such as pre-treatment, reverse osmosis, deionisation or EDI, UV treatment, TOC reduction or monitoring, ultrafiltration, storage, recirculation, pumps, valves, sensors and dispensers. Water-quality parameters including conductivity, resistivity, TOC, microbial load, particles and endotoxin-sensitive applications. Basic electrical, electronic, plumbing and mechanical fault diagnosis; safe use of service tools and test equipment. Techno-commercial proposals, product demonstrations, CRM or pipeline management, service documentation and customer complaint handling. 
 Behavioural Competencies Customer focus with the ability to listen carefully, diagnose needs and take ownership through closure. Commercial judgement balanced with technical accuracy, serviceability and lifecycle value. Structured problem-solving and calm decision-making at customer sites. Clear written and verbal communication with laboratory users, technical teams and senior stakeholders. Planning discipline, follow-through, data-based reporting and accountability for commitments. Collaboration across sales, service, product, operations and support functions. Integrity, safety awareness, learning agility and willingness to remain hands-on in the field.

description:
As the Senior Analyst - Credit and Collections, you will be responsible for managing the accounts receivable for a portfolio of customers, including collecting payments, maintaining records, and evaluating credit information to minimize credit risk. You will be responsible for contacting customers to confirm outstanding payments, obtain payment commitments and recommending solutions to remove impediments for future customer payments within the agreed payment terms. You will also mentor others with lower-level positions in Financial Services. Responsibilities: Reviews past due invoices and makes a high-volume of collection contacts via phone, e-mail, or customer portals. Works with the customer to determine root cause of dispute for unpaid or short-paid invoices. Obtains appropriate credit information to rate credit worthiness of new and existing accounts within assigned portfolio. Reviews and approves credit limits escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality. Works cross-functionally with sales, operations, finance, contract administration, and customer master administration teams to gather and review documents, including purchase orders, credit applications, and loads into contract tracking tool with recommendation of approval decision by financial services management and partners. Reviews orders on credit hold by assessing credit worthiness of customers, including financial ratings, open invoices, in-process payments, and backlog. Administer D365 licensing Base, Attach, Operations/Activity, and Team Member —right-sizing assignments to actual role requirements and identifying cost-reduction opportunities. Reconcile license consumption reports against assigned security roles and flag discrepancies, unused licenses, and users no longer with the organization. Bills of Materials (BOM) and Routing Administer BOM and formula structures, including creation, versioning, approval, activation, and expiration of BOM and route versions. Govern released product master data — item numbers, product dimensions, units of measure, costing, and item groups — that drives BOM accuracy. Build and maintain configuration rules so quoting and order entry produce valid, manufacturable, correctly priced configurations. Maintain configurator-driven BOM and route logic so that generated structures match engineering intent and part-numbering standards. Test and validate model changes in sandbox environments prior to production release; maintain regression test cases for high-volume product families. Administer configurator security so that model authoring is restricted to authorized users while sales and customer service retain appropriate run-time access. Troubleshoot configurator errors, failed configurations, and pricing anomalies raised by Sales, Customer Service, and Production; coordinate vendor/partner escalation when required. Experience with the D365 product configurator (constraint-based configuration models). Proficiency with the Data Management framework for imports, exports, and configuration packages. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences. title: Sr Transactions Manager
description:
The role 
 Were looking for a Manager, Transaction Management, to support some of the worlds largest companies(client s) across the world covering Asia (APAC) , Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and other parts of the globe. You ll be based in Gurugram, India. 

 What this job involves 
 Leading strategy, not just transactions. This is a strategic leadership role. Youll turn portfolio data and market insight into advice that shapes how some of the worlds largest companies use real estate across Globally. Youll own the delivery of complex transactions, but your biggest impact comes from setting account direction, advising senior stakeholders and building the teams, governance and analytics that keep the platform consistent across regions. The role blends hands-on ownership, team leadership and enterprise-level influence. Youll coordinate medium-complex transactions independently, lead high-complexity transactions end to end, and set the strategic agenda for multi-service accounts that span regions. 

 Key responsibilities 
 Lead transactions end to end: Independently coordinate medium-complex transactions and lead high-complexity ones, including lease acquisitions, renewals and terminations, with full delivery accountability. Direct broker and market strategy: Negotiate with brokers, challenge market inputs and direct strategy across the account portfolio to secure favorable positions. Uphold standards: Make sure account workflows, approval protocols and documentation standards are followed across the team, and that trackers, approval packs, lease inputs and critical dates are accurate. Present financial analysis: Present analyses to clients, including NPV, cash flow and PL models, with clear strategic and commercial implications. Manage RFPs and close actions: Direct RFP strategy and commercial positioning across the portfolio, coordinating legal and finance input through to award, and close open actions within agreed timelines. 

 Client and stakeholder partnership 
 Set account direction: Use deep knowledge of each clients business and portfolio to shape account strategy and hold relationship oversight across accounts. Coordinate stakeholders: Lead internal and external broker meetings and manage stakeholder expectations across regions. Lead workshops and strategic sessions, and lead client communication and presentations so expectations are managed directly. Anticipate and respond: Respond with urgency and flag risks before they affect delivery. Grow account value: Develop strategic solutions that strengthen account value and set the growth agenda across multi-service accounts. 

 Strategic advisory and platform governance 
 Portfolio strategy: Help define and deliver medium portfolio strategy advisory services to clients, providing strategic insights and recommendations that align with their business objectives Lead advisory on complex decisions: Advise senior client decision-makers on portfolio options, with clear rationale, risk assessment and recommendations. Set governance standards: Set governance and reporting standards, including quarterly business reviews and KPI reviews, for consistent delivery across the platform. Drive process improvement: Turn stakeholder feedback into workflow changes, redesign account workflows and embed the revised process across the team. Partner across service lines: Coordinate all service lines to deliver integrated, multi-service client solutions. 

 Digital, data and innovation 
 Champion the toolset: Use RFFT, MAPIT, Blackbird, SmartSheet, PAT, Excel, AI, dashboards and JLL GPT to improve speed, accuracy and consistency, and set the example for your team. Protect data quality: Maintain clean, structured data across trackers, reports and documentation. Automate: Identify manual, repetitive tasks, then build and deploy automation that measurably reduces effort and turnaround time. Standardize: Standardize templates and recurring deliverables as best practice for the team. 

 Culture and brand 
 Lead and develop teams: Lead teams of more than five people for extended periods (six months or more), organize day-to-day workload, mentor junior colleagues, and lead learning, development and knowledge management. Collaborate: Work effectively with peers, account teams, brokers and cross-functional teams across regions. Represent JLL: Demonstrate integrity, confidentiality and responsible ownership, and represent JLL with executive presence in senior client and leadership forums. 

 How youll work 
 Relationship management: Youll build strong, lasting relationships and help clients navigate the JLL delivery platform efficiently. Youll understand account profitability and shape account plans that meet revenue, performance and client service targets. Commercial acumen: Youll prepare and challenge financial analysis, contribute to client budget forecasting and forecast revenue, initiating and closing projects to meet monthly cashflow plans. Youll use technology and new products within JLL to deliver next-generation benefits for clients. Operating across regions: Can you see the bigger picture Can you juggle regional delivery that aligns to a global strategy As the Transaction Management lead supporting EMEA, APAC and Global accounts, youll bring each regions successes and risks to the forefront, offer practical solutions, and guide clients and teams toward proven processes and portfolio strategies.

title: Sr Manager - DFT
description:
Job Summary 
 Advance your career. Advance the world. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether re re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we ll advance your career. 
 
 The Role 
 As a Senior Manager - DFT Design within the S3 SoC DFT Team, the successful candidate will provide technical and people leadership for the DFT organization responsible for the architecture, design, integration, verification, and silicon enablement of advanced DFT solutions across complex SoCs. The candidate will lead a team of DFT engineers and work closely with DFT Architecture, RTL Design, Verification, Physical Design, STA, Test, and Post-Silicon teams to drive robust and scalable DFT solutions across multiple programs. This role requires a strong combination of deep DFT technical expertise, team leadership, execution ownership, and cross-functional collaboration . 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead and manage a team of DFT engineers responsible for end-to-end DFT design, integration, verification, and implementation. Provide technical leadership for complex DFT architectures including Scan, ATPG, MBIST, Boundary Scan/JTAG and related test methodologies . Own DFT execution from architecture and requirements definition through RTL implementation, verification, physical implementation support, pattern generation, and silicon bring-up. Partner closely with DFT Architecture and IP/SoC Design teams to define requirements and drive successful DFT implementation across complex SoCs. Drive correct-by-construction DFT methodologies , design quality, verification completeness, and predictable execution. Work closely with RTL Design, Verification, Physical Design, STA, and Test Engineering teams to resolve complex design, timing, implementation, and testability challenges. Lead technical reviews and provide guidance on DFT architecture, methodologies, implementation, verification, and debug. Drive execution planning, resource prioritization, risk identification, and timely closure of technical dependencies and program deliverables. Develop and improve DFT methodologies, automation, flows, and infrastructure to improve engineering productivity and design quality. Provide hands-on technical guidance for complex ATPG, scan, MBIST, timing, simulation, and silicon-debug issues. Build and develop engineering talent through mentoring, technical guidance, and capability development. Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed engineering teams and stakeholders. 
 
 Preferred Experience 
 Extensive experience in ASIC/SoC DFT architecture, design, integration, verification, and implementation . Strong experience leading end-to-end DFT execution for complex, high-performance SoCs . Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring DFT engineers and driving technical execution across multiple projects/programs. Deep understanding of Scan insertion, ATPG, compression, MBIST, Boundary Scan/JTAG, test modes and test architecture . Strong experience with industry-standard DFT and implementation tools such as Siemens Tessent, Synopsys Design Compiler and SpyGlass or equivalent tools. Experience defining and developing scalable DFT flows and methodologies. Strong knowledge of RTL development and integration using Verilog/SystemVerilog . Experience integrating multiple IPs and DFT structures into large and complex SoCs. Good understanding of synthesis, simulation, CDC, lint, RTL quality checks, and design verification methodologies. Strong understanding of Static Timing Analysis, DFT timing constraints and timing closure . Experience in Scan/ATPG pattern generation, test-flow development, debug, coverage analysis, and characterization. Excellent hands-on debugging skills with the ability to drive complex technical issues to closure. Strong scripting and automation experience using Python and TCL . Understanding of low-power design concepts including clock gating and power gating. Experience with post-silicon bring-up and silicon DFT/debug is highly desirable. Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and organizational skills with the ability to work effectively across global engineering teams. Proven ability to balance technical depth, people leadership, program execution, and strategic priorities . 
 
 Academic Credentials 
 B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. Typically 15+ years of relevant semiconductor/SoC design experience , with significant experience in DFT and technical/team leadership.

title: Business Finance Manager ( E-commerce)
description:
Role Overview 
 The Business Finance Manager E-commerce will be responsible for driving financial planning, business performance analysis, profitability, and financial governance for the e-commerce division. The role will partner closely with the e-commerce, sales, marketing, merchandising, supply chain, and operations teams to drive profitable growth, improve margins, optimize costs, and support data-driven business decisions. The ideal candidate will combine strong financial acumen with a commercial mindset and an understanding of e-commerce business models, marketplace economics, digital sales channels, and omnichannel retail operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Financial Planning and Budgeting Lead the annual budgeting, business planning, and forecasting process for the e-commerce division. Develop monthly and quarterly financial forecasts based on sales plans, business trends, and growth initiatives. Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions. Prepare financial models for new business initiatives, campaigns, channel expansion, and growth opportunities. 
 2. Business Performance and Profitability Monitor revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, EBITDA, and other key financial metrics. Analyze profitability across e-commerce channels, marketplaces, product categories, brands, and campaigns. Track key business drivers such as average order value, conversion rates, return rates, discounts, and customer acquisition costs. Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce costs, and enhance overall business performance. Provide actionable insights to business leaders to support strategic and operational decisions. 
 3. E-commerce Channel Finance Monitor financial performance across the companys website, third-party marketplaces, and other digital sales channels. Evaluate marketplace commissions, payment gateway charges, logistics costs, fulfilment expenses, promotional funding, and platform fees. Analyze the financial impact of discounting, promotions, returns, cancellations, and product-level pricing decisions. Review channel-level unit economics and recommend measures to improve contribution margins. Support commercial negotiations with marketplaces, logistics partners, and other service providers. 
 4. Management Reporting and Business Reviews Prepare monthly financial dashboards, MIS reports, and management review presentations. Provide timely insights on revenue growth, margins, costs, working capital, and profitability. Conduct monthly business performance reviews with e-commerce leadership. Highlight emerging financial risks, business trends, and opportunities for improvement. Establish relevant financial KPIs and reporting mechanisms for the division. 
 5. Working Capital and Cash Flow Management Monitor receivables from marketplaces and payment service providers. Track inventory levels, inventory ageing, stock rotation, and working capital requirements in collaboration with supply chain teams. Monitor cash flow, settlement cycles, payment deductions, and outstanding claims. Identify opportunities to optimize working capital and improve cash conversion cycles. Ensure timely reconciliation of marketplace settlements and resolution of financial discrepancies. 
 6. Cost Optimization and Financial Controls Identify cost-saving opportunities across marketing, logistics, fulfilment, technology, and operations. Evaluate the financial effectiveness and return on investment of marketing campaigns and promotional spends. Strengthen internal controls, financial processes, and compliance across e-commerce operations. Partner with accounting and tax teams to ensure accurate revenue recognition, GST compliance, and financial reporting. Ensure appropriate controls over discounts, refunds, returns, vendor payments, and marketplace deductions. 
 7. Business Partnering and Strategic Support Act as a finance business partner to the e-commerce business head and cross-functional leaders. Support pricing decisions, promotional strategies, product launches, and channel expansion. Evaluate business cases and investment proposals using financial modelling and return analysis. Translate financial data into practical business recommendations. Drive accountability for financial performance across relevant business stakeholders.

Job Title: AI Platform Engineering Manager Role Overview: EY GDSs Managed Services AI for AI team is looking for an AI Platform Engineering Manager to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape - multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. Youll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture. Key Responsibilities: Own platform deployment for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs). Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale. Architect for scale and resilience - ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets. Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers , setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines. Partner cross-functionally with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems. Manage model-hosting strategy , including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs. Build observability and monitoring for agentic systems - tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards. Drive security, compliance, and governance of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data). Optimize infrastructure cost and performance , balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments. Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap , advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments. What Were Looking For Experience 5-8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production. Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments. Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production. Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred. Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation). Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale. Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.). Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching). Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries. Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus) Soft Skills / Leadership Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders. Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership. Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment - building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones. What We Offer: A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact. Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement. A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth. Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in todays rapidly evolving technological landscape. EY | Building a better working world Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Manager / Senior Manager - Fraud & Risk Analyst
description:
About MobiKwik MobiKwik is India's leading Digital Financial Services platform and largest Digital Wallet, trusted by over 167 million users and 4.4 million businesses. As a pioneer in the Fintech space, MobiKwik offers digital payments, credit and investments, with a mission to democratize financial inclusion. Recently, MobiKwik achieved a significant milestone with its Initial Public Offering (IPO), marking a new chapter in its journey of innovation and growth. 
 About the Role We are looking for a fraud and risk professional with strong data analytics skills to build and scale a data-driven fraud, AML and risk intelligence function. This role sits at the intersection of fraud operations, data science and AI. You will own fraud detection and prevention strategy, build Early Warning Systems (EWS), risk models and scorecards, and enable real-time, automated risk monitoring across the organization. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Fraud Detection, Prevention & Investigation Lead the development and execution of fraud detection, prevention and investigation strategies. Implement systems and controls to monitor transactional activity and detect anomalies. Analyse fraud trends, investigate root causes and drive process improvements. Ensure timely resolution of fraud alerts and incidents, including customer recovery processes where applicable. Collaborate with product, operations, tech and customer experience teams to embed fraud controls into products and journeys. Build and manage a high-performing fraud operations team. 
 2. Risk Modeling, EWS & Scorecards Design and build Early Warning System (EWS) models using regression (linear, logistic) and classification techniques (tree-based and ensemble methods). Identify leading risk indicators across transactions, customer behavior and operational metrics, and define thresholds, triggers and alert logic. Build risk scorecards for customer risk, transaction risk / fraud signals and operational risk. Run simulations, scenario analysis and stress tests on models and thresholds. Develop anomaly detection frameworks, and continuously refine models using performance data and feedback loops. 
 3. Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & Compliance Oversee the AML compliance program in line with applicable regulations. Manage transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening and escalation of suspicious activity. Lead the filing of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) or equivalent with regulators. Update and enforce AML policies and procedures, conduct AML risk assessments, and coordinate internal audits and regulatory reviews. 
 4. Data, Automation & AI Write efficient SQL queries on large transactional and operational datasets. Build and manage data pipelines (ETL / ELT) for real-time and batch processing, ensuring data quality and scalability. Build and enhance risk monitoring dashboards with near real-time visibility, automated alerts and exception reporting. Work hands-on with Claude and other LLMs for risk signal extraction from unstructured data and incident summarization and classification. Build agentic AI workflows for automated alerts, intelligent monitoring and escalation, ensuring secure and compliant AI use. 
 5. Law Enforcement & Stakeholder Engagement Liaise with law enforcement agencies, including police and the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), and with partner banks to support fraud investigations and legal proceedings. Translate business problems into scalable analytical solutions for ERM, ORM, Product and Tech teams. Regularly report fraud KPIs, emerging risks and incident summaries to senior leadership. 
 What You'll Bring Qualifications & Experience B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Mathematics or a related field) preferred. Candidates with a degree in Finance, Law, Business or Statistics and strong analytics skills are also welcome. Master's degree is a plus. 710 years of experience in fraud prevention, risk or AML, preferably in fintech, payments, financial services or e-commerce. Proven experience leading teams and working with cross-functional stakeholders. Deep understanding of fraud typologies, AML regulations and financial crime frameworks. Certifications such as CAMS, CFE or CFCS are preferred. 
 Technical Skills (Mandatory) Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.). Advanced SQL skills. Hands-on experience in predictive modeling, scorecard development, anomaly detection and scenario analysis. Experience building data pipelines (ETL / ELT frameworks). Experience implementing and managing fraud / AML systems and tools. 
 AI & Emerging Tech Hands-on experience with Claude or similar LLMs. Understanding of agentic AI and workflow automation. 
 Key Competencies Strategic and data-driven mindset. Strong analytical and investigative skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. High integrity and sound judgment. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
 How Success Is Measured Accuracy and effectiveness of EWS and fraud models (precision, recall, early detection). Reduction in fraud losses and faster resolution of alerts and incidents. Performance of risk scorecards and predictive models. Reliability and scalability of data pipelines and monitoring dashboards. Level of automation in risk detection and reporting. 
 Why MobiKwik? Build a next-gen, AI-driven fraud and risk analytics function. Work on high-scale fintech data and real-time risk problems. High ownership at the intersection of fraud, data science and AI. Progressive career, reward and recognition driven culture, and lean hierarchy.
