Role Overview The Logistics Manager will manage the procurement, transportation, and delivery of agricultural machinery and silage across Cornexts supply network. The role involves coordinating machinery supplies from vendors to customers and procuring silage from fodder entrepreneurs for delivery to dairy farms. The incumbent will also oversee international shipments, transportation costs, delivery tracking, and accurate shipment documentation. Key Responsibilities 1. Machinery Procurement and Transportation Coordinate with approved machinery vendors for procurement, order confirmation, production readiness, and dispatch schedules. Ensure machinery specifications, quantities, prices, and delivery terms match approved purchase orders. Arrange suitable vehicles, loading equipment, and safe transportation of machinery to customers, warehouses, or project sites. Coordinate with the sales and service teams for customer delivery requirements, unloading arrangements, and installation readiness. Track shipments and resolve delays, shortages, transit damage, and delivery discrepancies. 2. Silage Procurement and Distribution Coordinate silage procurement from fodder entrepreneurs and approved suppliers based on customer demand and supply plans. Confirm availability, agreed pricing, bale quantities, weights, and dispatch readiness. Coordinate with production and quality teams to ensure silage meets approved quality and packaging requirements before dispatch. Plan timely deliveries to dairy farms, considering farm requirements, vehicle availability, loading capacity, and unloading schedules. Verify dispatched and received quantities and resolve weight differences, damaged bales, rejected material, or shortages. 3. Transporter and Vendor Management Identify, evaluate, and maintain a reliable network of transporters, machinery vendors, silage suppliers, and logistics partners. Negotiate freight rates and service terms within approved budgets. Plan routes, consolidate loads, and improve vehicle utilisation to control transportation costs. Monitor transporter performance against delivery timelines, safety requirements, and service commitments. Maintain alternative transport arrangements to manage urgent requirements and supply disruptions. 4. Documentation and Delivery Confirmation Verify purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills, lorry receipts, and other applicable dispatch documents. Ensure shipment details—including consignee information, quantities, weights, vehicle details, and delivery addresses—are accurate and consistent across documents. Collect signed delivery acknowledgements or proof of delivery from customers and dairy farms. Maintain complete shipment records and coordinate with finance to reconcile freight bills, supplier invoices, advances, and payment discrepancies. Ensure applicable documentation is available before dispatch and escalate discrepancies for correction. 5. International Logistics Manage import and export logistics for machinery, components, and other company products. Coordinate with overseas vendors, customers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, and insurance providers. Arrange and verify applicable shipping documents, including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or airway bills, certificates of origin, and customs documentation. Coordinate customs clearance, shipment insurance, port handling, and onward transportation. Monitor international shipment schedules and control freight, storage, demurrage, and detention costs. Work with finance and relevant specialists to ensure shipments follow applicable import/export requirements and agreed commercial terms. 6. Planning, Reporting, and Coordination Prepare procurement, dispatch, and delivery plans in coordination with sales, production, service, and finance teams. Maintain shipment trackers and provide timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders. Prepare periodic reports on logistics expenditure, pending deliveries, vendor performance, transit losses, and outstanding delivery acknowledgements. Develop and improve procedures for procurement coordination, dispatch, documentation, and delivery confirmation. Supervise logistics staff and ensure timely resolution of operational issues. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related discipline. Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience, with responsibility for end-to-end logistics operations. Experience in agricultural machinery, farm equipment, silage, animal feed, or related industries will be an advantage. Practical experience in machinery transportation, supplier coordination, and deliveries to rural locations. Working knowledge of international freight, customs clearance, shipping documentation, and Incoterms. Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP or logistics management systems. Required Skills Procurement coordination and vendor management. Freight negotiation and transportation cost control. Dispatch planning, shipment tracking, and problem-solving. Accurate documentation and record maintenance. Strong communication, negotiation, and team coordination. Ability to manage multiple shipments and urgent operational requirements. Key Performance Indicators On-time procurement, dispatch, and delivery. Freight cost control and vehicle utilisation. Accuracy and completeness of shipment documentation. Timely collection of delivery acknowledgements. Reduction in transit damage, shortages, and delivery complaints. Timely international shipment clearance and delivery. Timely reconciliation of supplier and transporter bills. Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel to vendor locations, fodder entrepreneur sites, warehouses, customer locations, dairy farms, and ports as required

Key Skills: Scheduling,Dispatch scheduling,Management,Logistics operations,Coordination,Logistics,Logistics coordination,Logistics management

title: Support Operations Lead
description:
Support Operations Lead Job Description
 
 Support Operations Lead
 Role Overview
 We are hiring a Support Operations Lead to own the operations side of customer support. You will pair with
 our Support Product Manager, and the two of you will own Support as a function together: you own how
 support runs, they own the products and tools it runs on.
 Your goal is simple to state and hard to do: learners get fast, correct, friendly help, and the support team
 runs on clear processes and the right metrics.
 
 Position Details
 Employment Type Full Time
 Experience 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, at manager level or
 above, in a consumer (B2C) product company
 Location Remote, Kolkata (preferred)
 Work Days 5 Days (official). Weekend work may be required depending on business
 requirements, as this is a Support position.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 What you will do
 • Own support operations end to end: queues, routing, SLAs, escalations, staffing and shift planning.
 • Pick the metrics that matter (first response time, resolution time, first contact resolution, CSAT, ticket
 volume per learner, backlog) and review them every week.
 • Design and document support processes, macros and escalation paths, and keep them current as the
 product changes.
 • Find the top reasons learners contact us, and work with the Support PM and other product teams to
 remove them at the source.
 • Work with the Support PM on bots, self-serve help and tooling. Bring the ground truth from the floor
 into what gets built.
 • Run quality: ticket audits, feedback loops and training for agents, including training on new product
 changes.
 • Lead and grow the support team leads, and build a culture of ownership and care for the learner. 
 What you bring
 • 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, with at least part of that as a manager or above, in
 a consumer (B2C) product company.
 • You have owned support metrics and can show a time you improved them, with the before and after
 numbers.
 • You have designed support processes from scratch or fixed broken ones: routing, SLAs, escalation,
 QA.
 • Hands-on with helpdesk and support tools (for example Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar) and
 with spreadsheets for analysis.
 • Comfortable working with product and tech teams, and able to turn a support problem into a clear ask.
 • Calm under pressure, with high volumes and a large, varied learner base.
 Nice to have
 • Edtech, subscriptions or other high-volume consumer services.
 • Experience rolling out chatbots, AI agents or self-serve help centres.
 • Support in multiple Indian languages.
 
 About be10X
 At be10X (Goenka Kachave LLP), we don't just teach AI – we turn it into a career weapon. We're an AI
 upskilling platform built to help working professionals unlock faster promotions, bigger salary hikes,
 sharper productivity, and career breakthroughs they didn't think were possible yet.
 Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, we've rewritten the career
 trajectories of over 5 million learners through cutting-edge programs spanning AI, Finance, Data, Product,
 and Business.
 And we're not just growing – we're scaling fast. A profitable, fully bootstrapped organization with INR
 500+ crore in annual recurring revenue, a 2,500+ member team, and 15 offices across Pune, Bengaluru &
 Kolkata, we're one of India's – and the globe's – fastest-growing EdTech organizations.   
 The Be10x Effect
 • Google's Official Stamp of Approval – Be10x is a certified Google partner, putting us in a league
 most training platforms only dream of reaching.
 • From Classrooms to Warships – We delivered classified-ready AI training for the Indian Navy: a
 2-day program covering Excel + AI and Power BI dashboards with AI-powered decision briefs, built
 around a strict "data never leaves the laptop" security framework.
 • Now Streaming: Our Own Success Story – Be10x's journey is featured on JioHotstar's "Bharat of
 My Dreams" (2026) – proof that we're not just building careers, we're telling their stories.
 • Star-Studded Sessions – Our stages have hosted names like Boman Irani, Ashneer Grover, and
 Imtiaz Ali, because we believe AI education deserves the same spotlight as prime-time TV.
 • Community First – Proud partners and contributors of the Ahmedabad Rotary Association, Assam
 Chief Minister Office (CMO) contributing to initiatives that create meaningful social and professional
 impact.
 • AI Masterclass with Rotary Ahmedabad – Be10x led the “Orenda Skyline AI Masterclass” at Pandit
 Deendayal Auditorium, Ahmedabad, with 500+ industrialists, professionals, Rotarians and students.
 • Assam Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Assam floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Bihar Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Bihar floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Official AI Partner – Afghanistan Cricket Board – Be10x is now the Official AI Partner of the
 Afghanistan Cricket Board, applying practical AI tools and workflows to support the board’s teams and
 operations.

title: Condition Monitoring Specialist - Field Service
description:
Job Summary 
 Career Area: Product Support 
 
 Role Definition 
 Provides first line of support, coordination of services, problem resolution and/or recommendations on selected products and services. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Addressing minor coverage issues and resolving minor complaints. Ensuring all customer communication is clearly documented. Answering inbound customer service inquiries. Providing health analysis or troubleshooting and redirecting them when appropriate. Identifying issues and determining appropriate course of action for effective resolution. Processing results from analysis of technical data Understand prime product or component health or status, if action is needed, and required next steps. 
 
 Skill Descriptors 
 
 Customer Focus 
 Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. Level Working Knowledge: Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them. Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations. Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities. Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations. Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations. 
 
 Data Gathering Analysis 
 Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment. Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies. Reports problems that arise in the data collection process. Participates in gathering and analyzing an organizations data based on requirements. Documents data from various sources and in various formats. Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques. 
 
 Service Excellence 
 Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner. Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent. Resolves common customer problems. Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action. Provides direct service to internal or external customers. Documents customer complaints in a timely manner. 
 
 Consulting 
 Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately. Level Basic Understanding: Explains the roles and responsibilities of a consultant. Lists the typical phases of a consulting assignment or project. Presents a professional image, especially when dealing with customers. Describes the consulting process and relationship with clients. 
 
 Decision Making and Critical Thinking 
 Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process. Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made. Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions. Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function. 
 
 Effective Communications 
 Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. 
 
 Problem Solving 
 Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives. Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder. Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information. Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution. Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems. 
 
 Relationship Management 
 Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions. Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis. Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction. Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship. Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

title: Support Operations Lead
description:
Support Operations Lead Job Description
 
 Support Operations Lead
 Role Overview
 We are hiring a Support Operations Lead to own the operations side of customer support. You will pair with
 our Support Product Manager, and the two of you will own Support as a function together: you own how
 support runs, they own the products and tools it runs on.
 Your goal is simple to state and hard to do: learners get fast, correct, friendly help, and the support team
 runs on clear processes and the right metrics.
 
 Position Details
 Employment Type Full Time
 Experience 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, at manager level or
 above, in a consumer (B2C) product company
 Location Remote, Kolkata (preferred)
 Work Days 5 Days (official). Weekend work may be required depending on business
 requirements, as this is a Support position.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 What you will do
 • Own support operations end to end: queues, routing, SLAs, escalations, staffing and shift planning.
 • Pick the metrics that matter (first response time, resolution time, first contact resolution, CSAT, ticket
 volume per learner, backlog) and review them every week.
 • Design and document support processes, macros and escalation paths, and keep them current as the
 product changes.
 • Find the top reasons learners contact us, and work with the Support PM and other product teams to
 remove them at the source.
 • Work with the Support PM on bots, self-serve help and tooling. Bring the ground truth from the floor
 into what gets built.
 • Run quality: ticket audits, feedback loops and training for agents, including training on new product
 changes.
 • Lead and grow the support team leads, and build a culture of ownership and care for the learner. 
 What you bring
 • 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, with at least part of that as a manager or above, in
 a consumer (B2C) product company.
 • You have owned support metrics and can show a time you improved them, with the before and after
 numbers.
 • You have designed support processes from scratch or fixed broken ones: routing, SLAs, escalation,
 QA.
 • Hands-on with helpdesk and support tools (for example Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar) and
 with spreadsheets for analysis.
 • Comfortable working with product and tech teams, and able to turn a support problem into a clear ask.
 • Calm under pressure, with high volumes and a large, varied learner base.
 Nice to have
 • Edtech, subscriptions or other high-volume consumer services.
 • Experience rolling out chatbots, AI agents or self-serve help centres.
 • Support in multiple Indian languages.
 
 About be10X
 At be10X (Goenka Kachave LLP), we don't just teach AI – we turn it into a career weapon. We're an AI
 upskilling platform built to help working professionals unlock faster promotions, bigger salary hikes,
 sharper productivity, and career breakthroughs they didn't think were possible yet.
 Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, we've rewritten the career
 trajectories of over 5 million learners through cutting-edge programs spanning AI, Finance, Data, Product,
 and Business.
 And we're not just growing – we're scaling fast. A profitable, fully bootstrapped organization with INR
 500+ crore in annual recurring revenue, a 2,500+ member team, and 15 offices across Pune, Bengaluru &
 Kolkata, we're one of India's – and the globe's – fastest-growing EdTech organizations.   
 The Be10x Effect
 • Google's Official Stamp of Approval – Be10x is a certified Google partner, putting us in a league
 most training platforms only dream of reaching.
 • From Classrooms to Warships – We delivered classified-ready AI training for the Indian Navy: a
 2-day program covering Excel + AI and Power BI dashboards with AI-powered decision briefs, built
 around a strict "data never leaves the laptop" security framework.
 • Now Streaming: Our Own Success Story – Be10x's journey is featured on JioHotstar's "Bharat of
 My Dreams" (2026) – proof that we're not just building careers, we're telling their stories.
 • Star-Studded Sessions – Our stages have hosted names like Boman Irani, Ashneer Grover, and
 Imtiaz Ali, because we believe AI education deserves the same spotlight as prime-time TV.
 • Community First – Proud partners and contributors of the Ahmedabad Rotary Association, Assam
 Chief Minister Office (CMO) contributing to initiatives that create meaningful social and professional
 impact.
 • AI Masterclass with Rotary Ahmedabad – Be10x led the “Orenda Skyline AI Masterclass” at Pandit
 Deendayal Auditorium, Ahmedabad, with 500+ industrialists, professionals, Rotarians and students.
 • Assam Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Assam floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Bihar Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Bihar floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Official AI Partner – Afghanistan Cricket Board – Be10x is now the Official AI Partner of the
 Afghanistan Cricket Board, applying practical AI tools and workflows to support the board’s teams and
 operations.
 Part of House of EdTech
 be10X is part of House of EdTech, a multi-entity upskilling group whose brands include Office Master, AI for
 Techies, Dr. Finance, Profit Uni, and SpringPad.

title: Sr Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate - Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot. This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift. The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads - diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads. Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating. Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included - done means running and observable, not merely configured. Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate. Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation. Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout. Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached. Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance. Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems - third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues - and drive permanent root-cause elimination. Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform. Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded. Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift. Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access. Produce the evidence that audits require - configuration baselines, change records, access reviews - generated automatically wherever possible. Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand. Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early. Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up. Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad. 
 
 Education and Professional Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification. Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation). 
 
 Area of Specialisation 
 Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads - Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams - at 50,000-user scale. Configuration-as-code for tenant settings - Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout - plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation. Microsoft Purview implementation - sensitivity labels, DLP, retention - and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them. Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure. 
 
 Experience Required 
 15 years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment. Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one. Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams - at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration. Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API. Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so. Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership. Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents. Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague. 
 
 Desirable 
 Experience in a regulated industry - pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare - including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control. Migration delivery at scale - on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
